# Catchability uncertainty

Catchability for the fished groups is uncertain.
We want to explore the parameter space around catchability values for the fished groups to understand how that affects the modelled versus observed yield


```{r}
# Function to randomize catchability only for fished species
randomize_catchability <- function(params, sdev = 0.1) {
  # Get current gear parameters
  gear_df <- gear_params(params)
  
  # Check if there's fishing happening (non-zero catchability)
  if(nrow(gear_df) > 0) {
    # Generate noise for each catchability value
    for(i in 1:nrow(gear_df)) {
      # Only add noise if catchability is non-zero (meaning it's fished)
      if(gear_df$catchability[i] > 0) {
        # Generate random noise
        noise <- rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = sdev)
        
        # Apply noise to catchability
        gear_df$catchability[i] <- gear_df$catchability[i] * exp(noise)
        
        # Ensure values stay between 0 and 1
        if(gear_df$catchability[i] > 1) gear_df$catchability[i] <- 1
        if(gear_df$catchability[i] < 0) gear_df$catchability[i] <- 0
      }
    }
    
    # Update parameters with new catchability values
    
    gear_params(params) <- gear_df
    
  }
  
  return(params)
}

# Function to run multiple simulations with randomized catchability for fished species
run_random_catchability_sims <- function(params, 
                                         n_sims = 10, 
                                         years = 170, 
                                         sd = 0.1, 
                                         effort_scen, 
                                         tol = .01,
                                         t_max = 500) {
  # List to store simulation results
  sim_results <- list()
  
  # Run simulations
  for(i in 1:n_sims) {
    # Create new parameters with randomized catchability
    rand_params <- randomize_catchability(params, sd = sd)
    
    # Run to steady state
    rand_params <- steady(rand_params, tol = tol, t_max = t_max)
    
    # Run simulation with provided effort scenario
    sim <- project(rand_params, effort = effort_scen)
    
    # Store results
    sim_results[[i]] <- sim
  }
  
  return(sim_results)
}
```

# Scale initial abundances

We developed a steady-state model for the contemporary time period (2010-2020), but we are now assessing the historical change in biomass and yield. Thinking about the implication of historical whaling in particular, we need to explore how different initial steady-states would influence how biomass, yield and size structure change over time by exploring what initial conditions would need to be to best fit the yield timeseries and the mean value observed biomass for 2010-2020.

# Combined Catchability and Abundance Scaling Uncertainty Assessment

This section implements a comprehensive uncertainty assessment that combines both catchability uncertainty for fished species and abundance scaling uncertainty for marine mammals. This approach allows us to explore the parameter space more thoroughly and find optimal parameter combinations that best match observed data.

**Key improvements incorporated from optimization scripts 11/12:**
- **Enhanced whale prioritization**: Whale species receive much higher weighting (5-10x) in fit evaluation
- **Additional performance metrics**: Beyond RMSE, includes MAE, bias, correlation, and relative error
- **Stricter steady-state criteria**: Minimum 1000 years t_max, tolerance ≤ 0.002
- **Enhanced spin-up protocol**: Multiple spin-up cycles with biomass stability validation
- **Biomass stability tolerance**: Final 50 years CV must be < 5% for stable simulations

## Setup for Combined Uncertainty Analysis

```{r combined-uncertainty-setup}
# Load required libraries for parallel processing and Latin Hypercube Sampling
library(parallel)
library(doParallel)
library(foreach)
library(lhs)  # For Latin Hypercube Sampling

# Load LHS comparison functions
source("LHS_Functions.R")

# Function to estimate completion time for different analysis sizes
estimate_analysis_times <- function(timing_results, target_sizes = c(1000, 5000, 10000, 20000, 50000)) {
  
  if (is.null(timing_results) || timing_results$successful_rate_per_hour == 0) {
    cat("No timing data available for estimation\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  rate_per_hour <- timing_results$successful_rate_per_hour
  
  cat("\n🎯 ESTIMATED ANALYSIS TIMES FOR DIFFERENT SIZES:\n")
  cat("Based on current rate of", round(rate_per_hour, 1), "successful simulations per hour\n")
  cat("=================================================\n")
  
  estimates <- data.frame(
    Simulations = target_sizes,
    Hours = target_sizes / rate_per_hour,
    Duration = sapply(target_sizes / rate_per_hour * 3600, format_duration),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(estimates)) {
    cat(sprintf("%6d simulations: %s\n", 
                estimates$Simulations[i], 
                estimates$Duration[i]))
  }
  
  return(estimates)
}

# =========================================================================
# TIME TRACKING AND ESTIMATION FUNCTIONS
# =========================================================================

# Function to format time duration nicely
format_duration <- function(seconds) {
  if (seconds < 60) {
    return(sprintf("%.1f seconds", seconds))
  } else if (seconds < 3600) {
    minutes <- seconds / 60
    return(sprintf("%.1f minutes", minutes))
  } else if (seconds < 86400) {
    hours <- seconds / 3600
    return(sprintf("%.1f hours", hours))
  } else {
    days <- seconds / 86400
    return(sprintf("%.1f days", days))
  }
}

# Function to estimate completion time
estimate_completion_time <- function(start_time, completed_sims, total_sims, target_sims = 10000) {
  current_time <- Sys.time()
  elapsed_time <- as.numeric(difftime(current_time, start_time, units = "secs"))
  
  if (completed_sims == 0) {
    return(list(
      elapsed = format_duration(elapsed_time),
      remaining_current = "Calculating...",
      remaining_target = "Calculating...",
      rate_per_hour = 0,
      eta_current = "Calculating...",
      eta_target = "Calculating..."
    ))
  }
  
  # Calculate simulation rate
  rate_per_second <- completed_sims / elapsed_time
  rate_per_hour <- rate_per_second * 3600
  
  # Estimate remaining time for current analysis
  remaining_sims_current <- total_sims - completed_sims
  remaining_seconds_current <- remaining_sims_current / rate_per_second
  
  # Estimate time for target analysis (10,000 sims)
  remaining_seconds_target <- target_sims / rate_per_second
  
  # Calculate ETAs
  eta_current <- current_time + remaining_seconds_current
  eta_target <- Sys.time() + remaining_seconds_target
  
  return(list(
    elapsed = format_duration(elapsed_time),
    remaining_current = format_duration(remaining_seconds_current),
    remaining_target = format_duration(remaining_seconds_target),
    rate_per_hour = round(rate_per_hour, 1),
    eta_current = format(eta_current, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    eta_target = format(eta_target, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    rate_per_second = round(rate_per_second, 3)
  ))
}

# Function to print progress update with time estimates
print_progress_update <- function(sim_id, total_sims, start_time, target_sims = 10000) {
  timing_info <- estimate_completion_time(start_time, sim_id, total_sims, target_sims)
  
  progress_percent <- round((sim_id / total_sims) * 100, 1)
  
  cat(sprintf("\n=== PROGRESS UPDATE: Simulation %d of %d (%.1f%%) ===\n", 
              sim_id, total_sims, progress_percent))
  cat(sprintf("⏱️  Elapsed time: %s\n", timing_info$elapsed))
  cat(sprintf("🚀 Simulation rate: %.1f sims/hour (%.3f sims/sec)\n", 
              timing_info$rate_per_hour, timing_info$rate_per_second))
  
  if (timing_info$remaining_current != "Calculating...") {
    cat(sprintf("⏳ Current analysis remaining: %s (ETA: %s)\n", 
                timing_info$remaining_current, timing_info$eta_current))
    cat(sprintf("🎯 For 10,000 sim analysis: %s (ETA: %s)\n", 
                timing_info$remaining_target, timing_info$eta_target))
  }
  cat("================================================\n")
}

# =========================================================================
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS FUNCTIONS FOR LHS UNCERTAINTY ANALYSIS
# =========================================================================

# Calculate sensitivity indices for parameters
calculate_sensitivity_indices <- function(results, lhs_params, 
                                        output_metric = "total_biomass",
                                        method = "sobol") {
  
  cat("Calculating sensitivity indices for", output_metric, "using", method, "method\n")
  
  # Extract parameter values and output metric
  n_sims <- length(results)
  valid_results <- which(!sapply(results, is.null))
  
  if (length(valid_results) < 10) {
    cat("Warning: Only", length(valid_results), "valid results for sensitivity analysis\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create parameter matrix
  param_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(valid_results), ncol = 3)
  colnames(param_matrix) <- c("catchability", "abundance", "gamma")
  
  # Extract output values
  output_values <- numeric(length(valid_results))
  
  for (i in seq_along(valid_results)) {
    sim_id <- valid_results[i]
    result <- results[[sim_id]]
    
    # Get parameter values used
    param_matrix[i, "catchability"] <- mean(lhs_params$catchability_factors[sim_id, ])
    param_matrix[i, "abundance"] <- mean(lhs_params$abundance_factors[sim_id, ])
    param_matrix[i, "gamma"] <- mean(lhs_params$gamma_factors[sim_id, ])
    
    # Get output metric
    if (output_metric == "total_biomass") {
      # Extract biomass from simulation object
      sim_biomass <- getBiomass(result$simulation)
      output_values[i] <- sum(sim_biomass[nrow(sim_biomass), ], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else if (output_metric == "composite_score") {
      # Use composite score from performance metrics
      if (!is.null(result$performance$composite_score)) {
        output_values[i] <- result$performance$composite_score
      } else {
        output_values[i] <- NA
      }
    } else if (output_metric == "total_weighted_rmse") {
      # Use the correct performance metric name
      if (!is.null(result$performance$total_weighted_rmse)) {
        output_values[i] <- result$performance$total_weighted_rmse
      } else {
        output_values[i] <- NA
      }
    } else if (output_metric == "biomass_stability") {
      # Calculate stability from simulation biomass
      sim_biomass <- getBiomass(result$simulation)
      total_biomass_ts <- rowSums(sim_biomass, na.rm = TRUE)
      # Calculate CV for last 50% of simulation
      last_half <- tail(total_biomass_ts, length(total_biomass_ts) / 2)
      output_values[i] <- sd(last_half, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(last_half, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      # Default: use composite score
      if (!is.null(result$performance$composite_score)) {
        output_values[i] <- result$performance$composite_score
      } else {
        output_values[i] <- NA
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Remove any NA values before correlation analysis
  valid_indices <- !is.na(output_values)
  if (sum(valid_indices) < 3) {
    cat("Warning: Too few valid output values for sensitivity analysis\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  param_matrix_clean <- param_matrix[valid_indices, ]
  output_values_clean <- output_values[valid_indices]
  
  # Calculate correlation-based sensitivity (Pearson and Spearman) with error handling
  tryCatch({
    sensitivity_pearson <- cor(param_matrix_clean, output_values_clean, method = "pearson")
    sensitivity_spearman <- cor(param_matrix_clean, output_values_clean, method = "spearman")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Warning: Correlation calculation failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    sensitivity_pearson <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(param_matrix_clean), ncol = 1)
    sensitivity_spearman <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(param_matrix_clean), ncol = 1)
    rownames(sensitivity_pearson) <- colnames(param_matrix_clean)
    rownames(sensitivity_spearman) <- colnames(param_matrix_clean)
  }, warning = function(w) {
    # Handle warnings (like zero standard deviation) gracefully
    cat("Note: Correlation calculation warning:", conditionMessage(w), "\n")
  })
  
  # Calculate variance-based sensitivity (simple approach)
  # Normalize parameters to [0,1] for comparison
  param_norm <- apply(param_matrix_clean, 2, function(x) {
    if (sd(x) == 0) return(rep(0.5, length(x)))  # Handle constant parameters
    (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
  })
  
  # Calculate partial variance contributions
  total_var <- var(output_values_clean)
  partial_vars <- numeric(3)
  names(partial_vars) <- colnames(param_matrix_clean)
  
  for (i in 1:3) {
    # Fit linear model with single parameter
    lm_single <- lm(output_values ~ param_norm[, i])
    partial_vars[i] <- var(fitted(lm_single)) / total_var
  }
  
  # Main effect indices (approximate)
  main_effects <- abs(sensitivity_pearson[, 1])^2
  names(main_effects) <- rownames(sensitivity_pearson)
  
  return(list(
    param_matrix = param_matrix,
    output_values = output_values,
    sensitivity_pearson = sensitivity_pearson[, 1],
    sensitivity_spearman = sensitivity_spearman[, 1],
    main_effects = main_effects,
    partial_variance = partial_vars,
    total_variance = total_var,
    valid_simulations = length(valid_results),
    output_metric = output_metric
  ))
}

# Species-specific sensitivity analysis
calculate_species_sensitivity <- function(results, lhs_params, marine_mammal_species) {
  
  cat("Calculating species-specific sensitivity indices\n")
  
  valid_results <- which(!sapply(results, is.null))
  if (length(valid_results) < 10) {
    cat("Warning: Only", length(valid_results), "valid results for species sensitivity analysis\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get species names from first valid result
  first_result <- results[[valid_results[1]]]
  sim_biomass <- getBiomass(first_result$simulation)
  # Fix: Species names are column names, not row names (rows are time points)
  all_species <- colnames(sim_biomass)
  
  # Initialize sensitivity storage
  species_sensitivity <- list()
  
  for (species in all_species) {
    cat("  Analyzing species:", species, "\n")
    
    # Extract biomass for this species across simulations
    species_biomass <- numeric(length(valid_results))
    param_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(valid_results), ncol = 3)
    colnames(param_matrix) <- c("catchability", "abundance", "gamma")
    
    for (i in seq_along(valid_results)) {
      sim_id <- valid_results[i]
      result <- results[[sim_id]]
      
      # Get species biomass from simulation object
      sim_biomass <- getBiomass(result$simulation)
      species_biomass[i] <- sim_biomass[nrow(sim_biomass), species]
      
      # Get parameter values
      if (species %in% marine_mammal_species) {
        # For marine mammals, gamma and abundance are relevant
        mammal_idx <- which(marine_mammal_species == species)
        param_matrix[i, "abundance"] <- lhs_params$abundance_factors[sim_id, mammal_idx]
        param_matrix[i, "gamma"] <- lhs_params$gamma_factors[sim_id, mammal_idx]
        param_matrix[i, "catchability"] <- 1  # No fishing for mammals
      } else {
        # For fished species, catchability is relevant
        fished_species <- setdiff(all_species, marine_mammal_species)
        if (species %in% fished_species) {
          fished_idx <- which(fished_species == species)
          if (fished_idx <= ncol(lhs_params$catchability_factors)) {
            param_matrix[i, "catchability"] <- lhs_params$catchability_factors[sim_id, fished_idx]
          }
        }
        param_matrix[i, "abundance"] <- 1  # Not varied for fished species
        param_matrix[i, "gamma"] <- 1      # Not varied for fished species
      }
    }
    
    # Calculate correlations for this species
    sensitivity_pearson <- cor(param_matrix, species_biomass, method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
    sensitivity_spearman <- cor(param_matrix, species_biomass, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
    
    # Store results
    species_sensitivity[[species]] <- list(
      biomass_values = species_biomass,
      param_matrix = param_matrix,
      sensitivity_pearson = sensitivity_pearson[, 1],
      sensitivity_spearman = sensitivity_spearman[, 1],
      is_marine_mammal = species %in% marine_mammal_species,
      mean_biomass = mean(species_biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
      cv_biomass = sd(species_biomass, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(species_biomass, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }
  
  return(species_sensitivity)
}

# Comprehensive sensitivity analysis
run_comprehensive_sensitivity_analysis <- function(results, lhs_params, marine_mammal_species) {
  
  cat("=== COMPREHENSIVE SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS ===\n")
  
  # Overall sensitivity for different metrics - using metrics that are actually available
  metrics <- c("total_biomass", "composite_score", "total_weighted_rmse", "biomass_stability")
  overall_sensitivity <- list()
  
  for (metric in metrics) {
    cat("Analyzing overall sensitivity for:", metric, "\n")
    overall_sensitivity[[metric]] <- calculate_sensitivity_indices(results, lhs_params, metric)
  }
  
  # Species-specific sensitivity
  species_sensitivity <- calculate_species_sensitivity(results, lhs_params, marine_mammal_species)
  
  return(list(
    overall = overall_sensitivity,
    species = species_sensitivity,
    summary = create_sensitivity_summary(overall_sensitivity, species_sensitivity)
  ))
}

# Create sensitivity summary
create_sensitivity_summary <- function(overall_sensitivity, species_sensitivity) {
  
  cat("Creating sensitivity analysis summary\n")
  
  summary_list <- list()
  
  # Overall parameter rankings
  if (!is.null(overall_sensitivity$total_biomass)) {
    total_biomass_ranking <- sort(abs(overall_sensitivity$total_biomass$sensitivity_pearson), decreasing = TRUE)
    summary_list$total_biomass_ranking <- total_biomass_ranking
  }
  
  if (!is.null(overall_sensitivity$total_yield)) {
    total_yield_ranking <- sort(abs(overall_sensitivity$total_yield$sensitivity_pearson), decreasing = TRUE)
    summary_list$total_yield_ranking <- total_yield_ranking
  }
  
  # Most sensitive species
  if (!is.null(species_sensitivity)) {
    species_cv <- sapply(species_sensitivity, function(x) x$cv_biomass)
    most_variable_species <- sort(species_cv, decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(5, length(species_cv))]
    summary_list$most_variable_species <- most_variable_species
    
    # Parameter effects by species type
    marine_mammals <- names(species_sensitivity)[sapply(species_sensitivity, function(x) x$is_marine_mammal)]
    fished_species <- names(species_sensitivity)[!sapply(species_sensitivity, function(x) x$is_marine_mammal)]
    
    summary_list$marine_mammals <- marine_mammals
    summary_list$fished_species <- fished_species
  }
  
  return(summary_list)
}

# ============================================================================
# 🎯 LATIN HYPERCUBE SAMPLING (LHS) PARAMETER GENERATION
# ============================================================================
# Generate LHS parameter combinations for more efficient parameter space exploration
generate_lhs_parameters <- function(n_sims, 
                                   catchability_sd = 0.4,
                                   abundance_sd = 0.8,
                                   gamma_sd = 0.3,  # NEW: Standard deviation for gamma (search rate) variation
                                   marine_mammal_species = c("minke whales", "orca", "sperm whales", "baleen whales"),
                                   params_object = NULL,
                                   seed = NULL) {
  
  if (!is.null(seed)) {
    set.seed(seed)
  }
  
  # Get number of fished species (for catchability parameters)
  if (!is.null(params_object)) {
    gear_df <- gear_params(params_object)
    n_fished_species <- sum(gear_df$catchability > 0)
  } else {
    # Default estimate based on typical Prydz Bay model
    n_fished_species <- 9  # Based on previous analysis
  }
  
  n_marine_mammals <- length(marine_mammal_species)
  
  # Total number of parameters to vary: catchability + abundance + gamma
  # Each marine mammal has both abundance and gamma parameters varied
  n_params <- n_fished_species + (n_marine_mammals * 2)  # *2 for abundance + gamma
  
  cat("=== LATIN HYPERCUBE SAMPLING SETUP ===\n")
  cat("Generating", n_sims, "parameter combinations using LHS\n")
  cat("  - Fished species (catchability):", n_fished_species, "\n")
  cat("  - Marine mammals (abundance + gamma):", n_marine_mammals, "\n")
  cat("  - Total parameters:", n_params, "\n")
  cat("  - Catchability SD:", catchability_sd, "(CV ≈", round(sqrt(exp(catchability_sd^2) - 1) * 100, 1), "%)\n")
  cat("  - Abundance SD:", abundance_sd, "(CV ≈", round(sqrt(exp(abundance_sd^2) - 1) * 100, 1), "%)\n")
  cat("  - Gamma SD:", gamma_sd, "(CV ≈", round(sqrt(exp(gamma_sd^2) - 1) * 100, 1), "%)\n\n")
  
  # Generate LHS design
  # This creates a matrix where each row is a simulation and each column is a parameter
  # Values are uniformly distributed between 0 and 1
  lhs_design <- randomLHS(n_sims, n_params)
  
  # Transform uniform [0,1] samples to normal distribution quantiles
  # Parameter structure: [catchability(n_fished) | abundance(n_mammals) | gamma(n_mammals)]
  
  # Convert uniform samples to normal samples using inverse normal CDF
  normal_samples <- qnorm(lhs_design)
  
  # Split into parameter sets
  catchability_samples <- normal_samples[, 1:n_fished_species, drop = FALSE] * catchability_sd
  abundance_samples <- normal_samples[, (n_fished_species + 1):(n_fished_species + n_marine_mammals), drop = FALSE] * abundance_sd
  gamma_samples <- normal_samples[, (n_fished_species + n_marine_mammals + 1):n_params, drop = FALSE] * gamma_sd
  
  # Convert to multiplicative factors (log-normal distribution)
  catchability_factors <- exp(catchability_samples)
  abundance_factors <- exp(abundance_samples)
  gamma_factors <- exp(gamma_samples)  # NEW: Gamma search rate factors
  
  # Create structured output
  lhs_parameters <- list(
    n_sims = n_sims,
    n_fished_species = n_fished_species,
    n_marine_mammals = n_marine_mammals,
    catchability_factors = catchability_factors,  # Each row is a simulation, each column is a species
    abundance_factors = abundance_factors,        # Each row is a simulation, each column is a marine mammal
    gamma_factors = gamma_factors,                # NEW: Each row is a simulation, each column is a marine mammal
    marine_mammal_species = marine_mammal_species,
    lhs_design_matrix = lhs_design,              # Original [0,1] design for diagnostics
    normal_samples = normal_samples,             # Normal samples for diagnostics
    parameter_sds = list(                        # NEW: Store SDs for sensitivity analysis
      catchability_sd = catchability_sd,
      abundance_sd = abundance_sd,
      gamma_sd = gamma_sd
    )
  )
  
  # Quality check: verify space-filling properties
  cat("=== LHS QUALITY ASSESSMENT ===\n")
  cat("Parameter space coverage check:\n")
  
  # Check coverage for catchability parameters
  catch_ranges <- apply(catchability_factors, 2, range)
  cat("  - Catchability factor ranges:\n")
  for (i in 1:ncol(catchability_factors)) {
    cat("    Species", i, ":", round(catch_ranges[1, i], 3), "-", round(catch_ranges[2, i], 3), 
        "(", round(catch_ranges[2, i] / catch_ranges[1, i], 1), "x range)\n")
  }
  
  # Check coverage for abundance parameters  
  abund_ranges <- apply(abundance_factors, 2, range)
  cat("  - Abundance factor ranges:\n")
  for (i in 1:ncol(abundance_factors)) {
    cat("    ", marine_mammal_species[i], ":", round(abund_ranges[1, i], 3), "-", round(abund_ranges[2, i], 3),
        "(", round(abund_ranges[2, i] / abund_ranges[1, i], 1), "x range)\n")
  }
  
  # Check coverage for gamma parameters (NEW)
  gamma_ranges <- apply(gamma_factors, 2, range)
  cat("  - Gamma (search rate) factor ranges:\n")
  for (i in 1:ncol(gamma_factors)) {
    cat("    ", marine_mammal_species[i], ":", round(gamma_ranges[1, i], 3), "-", round(gamma_ranges[2, i], 3),
        "(", round(gamma_ranges[2, i] / gamma_ranges[1, i], 1), "x range)\n")
  }
  
  # Calculate correlation matrix to verify low correlation (good space-filling)
  param_correlations <- cor(cbind(catchability_factors, abundance_factors, gamma_factors))
  max_off_diagonal_corr <- max(abs(param_correlations[upper.tri(param_correlations)]))
  cat("  - Maximum parameter correlation:", round(max_off_diagonal_corr, 3), 
      "(lower is better for LHS)\n\n")
  
  return(lhs_parameters)
}

# Function to apply LHS parameters to a single simulation
apply_lhs_parameters <- function(params, lhs_params, sim_index, marine_mammal_species, verbose = FALSE) {
  
  # Create copy of params
  rand_params <- params
  
  # Step 1: Apply catchability factors for fished species
  gear_df <- gear_params(rand_params)
  original_catchability <- gear_df$catchability
  
  if(nrow(gear_df) > 0) {
    fished_indices <- which(gear_df$catchability > 0)
    
    if (length(fished_indices) != lhs_params$n_fished_species) {
      warning("Mismatch between expected and actual number of fished species. Expected: ", 
              lhs_params$n_fished_species, ", Found: ", length(fished_indices))
    }
    
    # Apply LHS catchability factors
    for(j in seq_along(fished_indices)) {
      idx <- fished_indices[j]
      if (j <= ncol(lhs_params$catchability_factors)) {
        factor <- lhs_params$catchability_factors[sim_index, j]
        gear_df$catchability[idx] <- gear_df$catchability[idx] * factor
        gear_df$catchability[idx] <- min(1, max(0, gear_df$catchability[idx]))  # Keep in [0,1]
      }
    }
    gear_params(rand_params) <- gear_df
  }
  
  # Step 2: Apply abundance factors for marine mammals
  sp_params <- species_params(rand_params)
  species_indices <- which(sp_params$species %in% marine_mammal_species)
  
  if (length(species_indices) != lhs_params$n_marine_mammals) {
    warning("Mismatch between expected and actual number of marine mammal species. Expected: ",
            lhs_params$n_marine_mammals, ", Found: ", length(species_indices))
  }
  
  # Apply LHS abundance scaling factors
  for (k in seq_along(species_indices)) {
    if (k <= ncol(lhs_params$abundance_factors)) {
      scaling_factor <- lhs_params$abundance_factors[sim_index, k]
      rand_params@initial_n[species_indices[k],] <- 
        rand_params@initial_n[species_indices[k],] * scaling_factor
    }
  }
  
  # Step 3: Apply gamma (search rate) factors for marine mammals (NEW)
  original_gamma <- rand_params@species_params$gamma[species_indices]
  
  # Apply LHS gamma scaling factors
  for (k in seq_along(species_indices)) {
    if (k <= ncol(lhs_params$gamma_factors)) {
      gamma_factor <- lhs_params$gamma_factors[sim_index, k]
      rand_params@species_params$gamma[species_indices[k]] <- 
        rand_params@species_params$gamma[species_indices[k]] * gamma_factor
    }
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Simulation", sim_index, "LHS parameter application:\n")
    cat("  - Catchability factors:", paste(round(lhs_params$catchability_factors[sim_index,], 3), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    cat("  - Abundance factors:", paste(round(lhs_params$abundance_factors[sim_index,], 3), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    cat("  - Gamma factors:", paste(round(lhs_params$gamma_factors[sim_index,], 3), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  
  return(list(
    params = rand_params,
    applied_catchability_factors = lhs_params$catchability_factors[sim_index,],
    applied_abundance_factors = lhs_params$abundance_factors[sim_index,],
    applied_gamma_factors = lhs_params$gamma_factors[sim_index,],  # NEW
    original_catchability = original_catchability,
    original_gamma = original_gamma,  # NEW: Store original gamma values
    modified_catchability = gear_df$catchability,
    modified_gamma = rand_params@species_params$gamma[species_indices]  # NEW: Store modified gamma values
  ))
}

# Enhanced biomass stability check function with diagnostics
check_biomass_stability_enhanced <- function(sim_object, tolerance = 0.05, check_years = 50, 
                                            verbose = FALSE, sim_id = NULL) {
  # Check the coefficient of variation for the last check_years
  biomass <- getBiomass(sim_object)
  
  if (nrow(biomass) < check_years) {
    if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
      cat("Sim", sim_id, ": Insufficient data (", nrow(biomass), "years < ", check_years, "required)\n")
    }
    return(list(stable = FALSE, reason = "insufficient_data", cv_values = NULL))
  }
  
  # Get last check_years of data
  recent_biomass <- tail(biomass, check_years)
  
  # Calculate CV for each species
  cv_by_species <- apply(recent_biomass, 2, function(x) {
    if (mean(x) == 0) return(Inf)
    sd(x) / mean(x)
  })
  
  # Check if all species have CV below tolerance
  all_stable <- all(cv_by_species < tolerance, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Detailed diagnostics
  if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
    cat("Sim", sim_id, "stability check:\n")
    cat("  - Tolerance:", tolerance * 100, "% CV\n")
    cat("  - Check period: last", check_years, "years\n")
    
    unstable_species <- names(cv_by_species)[cv_by_species >= tolerance]
    stable_species <- names(cv_by_species)[cv_by_species < tolerance]
    
    if (length(unstable_species) > 0) {
      cat("  - UNSTABLE (", length(unstable_species), "/", length(cv_by_species), "): ")
      for (sp in unstable_species) {
        cat(sp, "(", round(cv_by_species[sp] * 100, 1), "%) ")
      }
      cat("\n")
    }
    
    if (length(stable_species) > 0) {
      cat("  - Stable (", length(stable_species), "/", length(cv_by_species), "): ")
      for (sp in stable_species) {
        cat(sp, "(", round(cv_by_species[sp] * 100, 1), "%) ")
      }
      cat("\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Return detailed results for non-verbose calls
  if (!verbose) {
    return(all_stable)
  } else {
    return(list(
      stable = all_stable,
      cv_values = cv_by_species,
      n_stable = sum(cv_by_species < tolerance, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_unstable = sum(cv_by_species >= tolerance, na.rm = TRUE),
      worst_cv = max(cv_by_species, na.rm = TRUE),
      worst_species = names(cv_by_species)[which.max(cv_by_species)]
    ))
  }
}

# Enhanced steady-state function with stricter criteria and diagnostics
enhanced_steady_state <- function(params, 
                                  tol = 0.002,           # Stricter tolerance
                                  t_max = 1000,          # Minimum 1000 years
                                  preserve_erepro = TRUE,
                                  max_attempts = 3,
                                  verbose = FALSE,
                                  sim_id = NULL) {
  
  attempt <- 1
  steady_successful <- FALSE
  original_t_max <- t_max
  
  while (attempt <= max_attempts && !steady_successful) {
    if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
      cat("Sim", sim_id, "steady-state attempt", attempt, "of", max_attempts, 
          "(tol =", tol, ", t_max =", t_max, ")\n")
    }
    
    tryCatch({
      if (preserve_erepro) {
        params_steady <- steady(params, tol = tol, t_max = t_max, preserve = c("erepro"))
      } else {
        params_steady <- steady(params, tol = tol, t_max = t_max)
      }
      
      # Validate steady state by running a longer simulation consistent with spinup requirements
      test_sim <- project(params_steady, t_max = 118, effort = 0)  # Use minimum spinup length
      stability_check <- check_biomass_stability_enhanced(test_sim, tolerance = 0.10,  # 10% CV tolerance
                                                         check_years = 20, verbose = FALSE)
      
      if (is.logical(stability_check) && stability_check) {
        if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
          cat("Sim", sim_id, "steady-state achieved and validated (attempt", attempt, ")\n")
        }
        steady_successful <- TRUE
        return(params_steady)
      } else {
        if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
          cat("Sim", sim_id, "steady-state converged but not stable (attempt", attempt, ")\n")
        }
        
        # Instead of just increasing t_max, make small parameter adjustments
        # This gives the system a chance to find a more stable configuration
        if (attempt < max_attempts) {
          # Make small random adjustments to abundance to help find stability
          sp_params <- species_params(params)
          for (i in 1:nrow(sp_params)) {
            if (runif(1) < 0.3) {  # 30% chance to adjust each species
              adjustment <- runif(1, 0.95, 1.05)  # ±5% adjustment
              params@initial_n[i,] <- params@initial_n[i,] * adjustment
            }
          }
          t_max <- original_t_max  # Reset t_max since we're trying new parameters
        }
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
        cat("Sim", sim_id, "steady-state failed:", e$message, "\nTrying again with parameter adjustment\n")
      }
      # Small parameter adjustment on error too
      if (attempt < max_attempts) {
        sp_params <- species_params(params)
        for (i in 1:nrow(sp_params)) {
          if (runif(1) < 0.2) {  # 20% chance to adjust each species
            adjustment <- runif(1, 0.98, 1.02)  # ±2% adjustment
            params@initial_n[i,] <- params@initial_n[i,] * adjustment
          }
        }
      }
    })
    
    attempt <- attempt + 1
  }
  
  # If all attempts failed, return original params with warning
  if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
    cat("Sim", sim_id, "steady-state failed after", max_attempts, "attempts. Using original parameters.\n")
  }
  return(list(params = params, steady_failed = TRUE))
}

# Enhanced spin-up function with multiple cycles and stability checks
enhanced_spinup <- function(params,
                           spinup_years = 118,
                           spinup_multiplier = 1,    # Can be 2, 3, or 4 for extended spinup
                           effort_scenario,
                           stability_tolerance = 0.10,  # Updated default to 10% based on test results
                           t_start = 1841,
                           final_years = 170,
                           verbose = FALSE,
                           sim_id = NULL) {
  
  total_spinup_years <- spinup_years * spinup_multiplier
  if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
    cat("Sim", sim_id, "running enhanced spinup for", total_spinup_years, "years (", 
        spinup_multiplier, "x base period)\n")
  }
  
  # Step 1: Initial spinup without fishing
  sim_spinup <- project(params, 
                       t_start = t_start, 
                       t_max = total_spinup_years,
                       effort = 0)
  
  # Step 2: Check biomass stability during spinup (NO FISHING PERIOD)
  # This is the key fix - we check stability on the spinup simulation, not the final one
  spinup_stability_check <- check_biomass_stability_enhanced(sim_spinup, 
                                                            tolerance = stability_tolerance, 
                                                            check_years = min(50, total_spinup_years),
                                                            verbose = verbose,
                                                            sim_id = sim_id)
  
  # Handle both return formats
  if (is.list(spinup_stability_check)) {
    is_stable <- spinup_stability_check$stable
  } else {
    is_stable <- spinup_stability_check
  }
  
  if (!is_stable) {
    if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
      cat("Sim", sim_id, "spinup not stable, extending by 50%\n")
    }
    # Extend spinup if not stable
    extended_spinup <- project(params,
                              initial_n = sim_spinup@n[total_spinup_years,,],
                              t_start = t_start + total_spinup_years,
                              t_max = round(total_spinup_years * 0.5),
                              effort = 0)
    
    # Check stability of extended spinup
    extended_stability_check <- check_biomass_stability_enhanced(extended_spinup, 
                                                                tolerance = stability_tolerance, 
                                                                check_years = min(30, round(total_spinup_years * 0.5)),
                                                                verbose = verbose,
                                                                sim_id = sim_id)
    
    if (is.list(extended_stability_check)) {
      is_stable <- extended_stability_check$stable
    } else {
      is_stable <- extended_stability_check
    }
    
    final_initial_n <- extended_spinup@n[round(total_spinup_years * 0.5),,]
  } else {
    if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
      cat("Sim", sim_id, "spinup achieved stability\n")
    }
    final_initial_n <- sim_spinup@n[total_spinup_years,,]
  }
  
  # Step 3: Run main simulation with fishing effort
  # This simulation will have variability due to fishing - that's expected and normal!
  sim_final <- project(params,
                      initial_n = final_initial_n,
                      t_start = t_start,
                      t_max = final_years,
                      effort = effort_scenario)
  
  return(list(
    simulation = sim_final,
    spinup_stable = is_stable,
    final_initial_n = final_initial_n,
    spinup_simulation = sim_spinup  # Return spinup sim for diagnostics if needed
  ))
}

# Enhanced model performance evaluation with multiple metrics
calculate_enhanced_performance_metrics <- function(sim_object,
                                                  yield_obs_data,
                                                  species_weights_df = species_weights,
                                                  species_list = NULL,
                                                  year_range = NULL) {
  
  # Get modeled yield 
  mod_yield <- getYield(sim_object)
  df_mod <- reshape2::melt(mod_yield)
  names(df_mod) <- c("Year", "Species", "Yield")
  
  # Filter by year range and species if specified
  if (!is.null(year_range)) {
    df_mod <- df_mod[df_mod$Year >= min(year_range) & df_mod$Year <= max(year_range), ]
    yield_obs_data <- yield_obs_data[yield_obs_data$Year >= min(year_range) &
                                     yield_obs_data$Year <= max(year_range), ]
  }
  
  if (!is.null(species_list)) {
    df_mod <- df_mod[df_mod$Species %in% species_list, ]
    yield_obs_data <- yield_obs_data[yield_obs_data$Species %in% species_list, ]
  }
  
  # Merge modeled and observed data
  comparison <- merge(df_mod, yield_obs_data,
                     by = c("Year", "Species"),
                     suffixes = c("_mod", "_obs"))
  
  # Calculate comprehensive metrics by species
  metrics_by_species <- comparison %>%
    group_by(Species) %>%
    summarise(
      RMSE = sqrt(mean((Yield_mod - Yield_obs)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      MAE = mean(abs(Yield_mod - Yield_obs), na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Obs = mean(Yield_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Mod = mean(Yield_mod, na.rm = TRUE),
      Bias = mean(Yield_mod - Yield_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
      Relative_Error = sqrt(mean((Yield_mod - Yield_obs)^2, na.rm = TRUE)) / mean(Yield_obs, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      Correlation = cor(Yield_mod, Yield_obs, use = "complete.obs"),
      MAPE = mean(abs((Yield_mod - Yield_obs) / Yield_obs), na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      n_obs = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Apply species weights and calculate weighted metrics
  metrics_weighted <- metrics_by_species %>%
    left_join(species_weights_df, by = "Species") %>%
    mutate(weight = ifelse(is.na(weight), 1, weight)) # Default weight of 1 for unspecified species
  
  # Calculate weighted overall metrics
  total_weighted_rmse <- weighted.mean(metrics_weighted$RMSE, 
                                       metrics_weighted$weight * metrics_weighted$n_obs, 
                                       na.rm = TRUE)
  
  total_weighted_mae <- weighted.mean(metrics_weighted$MAE,
                                      metrics_weighted$weight * metrics_weighted$n_obs,
                                      na.rm = TRUE)
  
  total_weighted_bias <- weighted.mean(metrics_weighted$Bias,
                                       metrics_weighted$weight * metrics_weighted$n_obs,
                                       na.rm = TRUE)
  
  avg_correlation <- mean(metrics_weighted$Correlation, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # ============================================================================
  # 🎯 COMPOSITE SCORE CALCULATION (MAIN EVALUATION POINT)
  # ============================================================================
  # Option 1: Current weighted approach (emphasizes RMSE)
  # Calculate composite score (lower is better)
  # Combines multiple metrics with emphasis on RMSE
  composite_score_weighted <- (total_weighted_rmse * 0.4) +     # 40% weight: How far off predictions are (Root Mean Square Error)
                             (total_weighted_mae * 0.3) +       # 30% weight: Average absolute difference (Mean Absolute Error)  
                             (abs(total_weighted_bias) * 0.2) + # 20% weight: Systematic over/under-prediction (Bias)
                             ((1 - avg_correlation) * 0.1)      # 10% weight: How well patterns match (1 minus Correlation)
  
  # Option 2: Equal weighting approach (balanced contribution)
  composite_score_equal <- (total_weighted_rmse * 0.25) +       # 25% weight: How far off predictions are
                          (total_weighted_mae * 0.25) +         # 25% weight: Average absolute difference
                          (abs(total_weighted_bias) * 0.25) +   # 25% weight: Systematic over/under-prediction
                          ((1 - avg_correlation) * 0.25)        # 25% weight: How well patterns match
  
  # Default to weighted approach for backward compatibility
  composite_score <- composite_score_weighted
  # ============================================================================
  
  return(list(
    total_weighted_rmse = total_weighted_rmse,
    total_weighted_mae = total_weighted_mae,
    total_weighted_bias = total_weighted_bias,
    avg_correlation = avg_correlation,
    composite_score = composite_score,
    composite_score_weighted = composite_score_weighted,
    composite_score_equal = composite_score_equal,
    metrics_by_species = metrics_by_species,
    metrics_weighted = metrics_weighted,
    comparison_data = comparison
  ))
}

# Function to run a single simulation with LHS parameters and enhanced protocols
run_lhs_enhanced_single_sim <- function(sim_id, params, lhs_params,
                                       marine_mammal_species, effort_scen, 
                                       enhanced_steady_tol, enhanced_steady_t_max,
                                       spinup_years, spinup_multiplier,
                                       t_start, sim_years,
                                       preserve_erepro, max_erepro,
                                       species_weights_df,
                                       yield_obs_data,
                                       verbose = FALSE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("=== Starting LHS enhanced simulation", sim_id, "===\n")
  }
  
  # Apply LHS parameters to create randomized params
  lhs_result <- apply_lhs_parameters(params, lhs_params, sim_id, marine_mammal_species, verbose)
  rand_params <- lhs_result$params
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Sim", sim_id, "LHS parameter modifications applied\n")
  }
  
  # Step 3: Enhanced steady state (same as before)
  steady_result <- enhanced_steady_state(rand_params, 
                                       tol = enhanced_steady_tol,
                                       t_max = enhanced_steady_t_max,
                                       preserve_erepro = preserve_erepro,
                                       verbose = verbose,
                                       sim_id = sim_id)
  
  # Check if steady state failed
  if (is.list(steady_result) && !is.null(steady_result$steady_failed)) {
    return(list(
      success = FALSE,
      reason = "steady_state_failed",
      sim_id = sim_id,
      details = "Could not achieve steady state within max attempts"
    ))
  }
  
  rand_params <- steady_result
  
  # Check erepro if not preserving
  if (!preserve_erepro) {
    current_erepro <- species_params(rand_params)$erepro
    if (any(current_erepro > max_erepro, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      return(list(
        success = FALSE,
        reason = "erepro_exceeded",
        sim_id = sim_id,
        details = paste("Max erepro:", round(max(current_erepro, na.rm = TRUE), 3))
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # Step 4: Enhanced spinup and main simulation (same as before)
  sim_result <- enhanced_spinup(rand_params,
                               spinup_years = spinup_years,
                               spinup_multiplier = spinup_multiplier,
                               effort_scenario = effort_scen,
                               stability_tolerance = 0.10,
                               t_start = t_start,
                               final_years = sim_years,
                               verbose = verbose,
                               sim_id = sim_id)
  
  # Step 5: Check if spinup achieved stability
  if (!sim_result$spinup_stable) {
    return(list(
      success = FALSE,
      reason = "spinup_instability",
      sim_id = sim_id,
      details = "Spinup period did not achieve biomass stability (>10% CV)"
    ))
  }
  
  if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
    cat("Sim", sim_id, "spinup was stable, simulation completed successfully\n")
  }
  
  # Step 6: Calculate enhanced performance metrics (same as before)
  performance <- calculate_enhanced_performance_metrics(sim_result$simulation,
                                                       yield_obs_data,
                                                       species_weights_df)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Sim", sim_id, "completed successfully. Composite score:", 
        round(performance$composite_score, 4), "\n")
  }
  
  return(list(
    success = TRUE,
    sim_id = sim_id,
    simulation = sim_result$simulation,
    performance = performance,
    spinup_stable = sim_result$spinup_stable,
    params_info = list(
      sim_id = sim_id,
      catchability = lhs_result$modified_catchability,
      catchability_change = lhs_result$modified_catchability / lhs_result$original_catchability,
      catchability_factors = lhs_result$applied_catchability_factors,
      marine_mammal_scaling = lhs_result$applied_abundance_factors,
      marine_mammal_species = marine_mammal_species,
      erepro_values = species_params(rand_params)$erepro,
      lhs_design_row = lhs_params$lhs_design_matrix[sim_id,]  # Store LHS design for analysis
    )
  ))
}

# Function to run a single simulation with enhanced protocols and diagnostics
run_enhanced_single_sim <- function(sim_id, params, catchability_sd, abundance_sd,
                                   marine_mammal_species, effort_scen, 
                                   enhanced_steady_tol, enhanced_steady_t_max,
                                   spinup_years, spinup_multiplier,
                                   t_start, sim_years,
                                   preserve_erepro, max_erepro,
                                   species_weights_df,
                                   yield_obs_data,
                                   verbose = FALSE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("=== Starting enhanced simulation", sim_id, "===\n")
  }
  
  # Create copy of params
  rand_params <- params
  
  # Step 1: Randomize catchability for fished species
  gear_df <- gear_params(rand_params)
  original_catchability <- gear_df$catchability
  
  if(nrow(gear_df) > 0) {
    for(j in 1:nrow(gear_df)) {
      if(gear_df$catchability[j] > 0) {
        noise <- rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = catchability_sd)
        gear_df$catchability[j] <- gear_df$catchability[j] * exp(noise)
        gear_df$catchability[j] <- min(1, max(0, gear_df$catchability[j]))
      }
    }
    gear_params(rand_params) <- gear_df
  }
  
  # Step 2: Randomize marine mammal abundance
  sp_params <- species_params(rand_params)
  species_indices <- which(sp_params$species %in% marine_mammal_species)
  scaling_factors <- exp(rnorm(length(species_indices), mean = 0, sd = abundance_sd))
  
  for (k in seq_along(species_indices)) {
    rand_params@initial_n[species_indices[k],] <-
      rand_params@initial_n[species_indices[k],] * scaling_factors[k]
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Sim", sim_id, "parameter modifications:\n")
    cat("  - Catchability changes: ", paste(round(gear_df$catchability / original_catchability, 2), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    cat("  - Marine mammal scaling: ", paste(round(scaling_factors, 2), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  
  # Step 3: Enhanced steady state
  steady_result <- enhanced_steady_state(rand_params, 
                                       tol = enhanced_steady_tol,
                                       t_max = enhanced_steady_t_max,
                                       preserve_erepro = preserve_erepro,
                                       verbose = verbose,
                                       sim_id = sim_id)
  
  # Check if steady state failed
  if (is.list(steady_result) && !is.null(steady_result$steady_failed)) {
    return(list(
      success = FALSE,
      reason = "steady_state_failed",
      sim_id = sim_id,
      details = "Could not achieve steady state within max attempts"
    ))
  }
  
  rand_params <- steady_result
  
  # Check erepro if not preserving
  if (!preserve_erepro) {
    current_erepro <- species_params(rand_params)$erepro
    if (any(current_erepro > max_erepro, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      return(list(
        success = FALSE,
        reason = "erepro_exceeded",
        sim_id = sim_id,
        details = paste("Max erepro:", round(max(current_erepro, na.rm = TRUE), 3))
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # Step 4: Enhanced spinup and main simulation
  sim_result <- enhanced_spinup(rand_params,
                               spinup_years = spinup_years,
                               spinup_multiplier = spinup_multiplier,
                               effort_scenario = effort_scen,
                               stability_tolerance = 0.10,  # Use 10% CV threshold for spinup stability
                               t_start = t_start,
                               final_years = sim_years,
                               verbose = verbose,
                               sim_id = sim_id)
  
  # Step 5: Check if spinup achieved stability - this is the only stability check we need!
  # The final simulation with fishing is SUPPOSED to have variability
  if (!sim_result$spinup_stable) {
    return(list(
      success = FALSE,
      reason = "spinup_instability",
      sim_id = sim_id,
      details = "Spinup period did not achieve biomass stability (>10% CV)"
    ))
  }
  
  if (verbose && !is.null(sim_id)) {
    cat("Sim", sim_id, "spinup was stable, simulation completed successfully\n")
  }
  
  # Step 6: Calculate enhanced performance metrics
  performance <- calculate_enhanced_performance_metrics(sim_result$simulation,
                                                       yield_obs_data,
                                                       species_weights_df)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Sim", sim_id, "completed successfully. Composite score:", 
        round(performance$composite_score, 4), "\n")
  }
  
  return(list(
    success = TRUE,
    sim_id = sim_id,
    simulation = sim_result$simulation,
    performance = performance,
    spinup_stable = sim_result$spinup_stable,
    params_info = list(
      sim_id = sim_id,
      catchability = gear_df$catchability,
      catchability_change = gear_df$catchability / original_catchability,
      marine_mammal_scaling = scaling_factors,
      marine_mammal_species = marine_mammal_species[seq_along(scaling_factors)],
      erepro_values = species_params(rand_params)$erepro
    )
  ))
}

# Main function to run enhanced combined uncertainty simulations
run_enhanced_combined_uncertainty_sims <- function(params,
                                                   n_sims = 10,
                                                   catchability_sd = 0.1,
                                                   abundance_sd = 0.2,
                                                   marine_mammal_species = NULL,
                                                   effort_scen,
                                                   enhanced_steady_tol = 0.002,      # Stricter tolerance
                                                   enhanced_steady_t_max = 1000,     # Minimum 1000 years
                                                   spinup_years = 118,
                                                   spinup_multiplier = 2,             # 2x base spinup by default
                                                   t_start = 1841,
                                                   sim_years = 170,
                                                   preserve_erepro = TRUE,
                                                   max_erepro = 1,
                                                   species_weights_df = species_weights,
                                                   yield_obs_data,
                                                   n_cores = NULL,
                                                   parallel = TRUE) {
  
  # Default marine mammal species if not specified
  if (is.null(marine_mammal_species)) {
    marine_mammal_species <- c("minke whales", "orca", "sperm whales", "baleen whales")
  }
  
  # Determine number of cores to use
  if (is.null(n_cores)) {
    n_cores <- detectCores() - 1
  }
  n_cores <- min(n_cores, detectCores())
  
  # Progress message
  cat("=== ENHANCED COMBINED UNCERTAINTY ANALYSIS ===\n")
  cat("Running", n_sims, "simulations with enhanced protocols:\n")
  cat("  - Steady-state tolerance:", enhanced_steady_tol, "\n")
  cat("  - Minimum steady-state time:", enhanced_steady_t_max, "years\n")
  cat("  - Spinup multiplier:", spinup_multiplier, "x (", spinup_years * spinup_multiplier, "years total)\n")
  cat("  - Whale species weighting: 3-10x higher than fish/krill\n")
  cat("  - Performance metrics: RMSE, MAE, Bias, Correlation, Composite Score\n")
  
  if (preserve_erepro) {
    cat("  - Preserving erepro values during steady state\n")
  } else {
    cat("  - Will skip simulations with erepro >", max_erepro, "\n")
  }
  
  if (parallel && n_cores > 1) {
    cat("  - Using parallel processing with", n_cores, "cores\n")
    
    # Set up parallel cluster
    cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)
    registerDoParallel(cl)
    
    # Export necessary objects to cluster
    clusterExport(cl, c("run_enhanced_single_sim", "enhanced_steady_state", 
                       "enhanced_spinup", "check_biomass_stability_enhanced",
                       "calculate_enhanced_performance_metrics", "calculate_yield_rmse",
                       "species_weights_df"), 
                  envir = environment())
    
    # Export yield data for any legacy references in cluster functions
    clusterExport(cl, "yield_obs_data", envir = environment())
    
    # Also create yield_ts_tidy alias in cluster environment for backward compatibility
    clusterEvalQ(cl, {
      yield_ts_tidy <- yield_obs_data
    })
    
    # Run simulations in parallel
    n_attempts <- ifelse(preserve_erepro, n_sims, ceiling(n_sims * 2))
    
    cat("  - Running", n_attempts, "initial attempts...\n")
    
    results <- foreach(i = 1:n_attempts,
                      .packages = c("mizer", "therMizer", "dplyr"),
                      .errorhandling = "pass") %dopar% {
      run_enhanced_single_sim(i, params, catchability_sd, abundance_sd,
                             marine_mammal_species, effort_scen, 
                             enhanced_steady_tol, enhanced_steady_t_max,
                             spinup_years, spinup_multiplier,
                             t_start, sim_years,
                             preserve_erepro, max_erepro,
                             species_weights_df, yield_obs_data)
    }
    
    # Stop cluster
    stopCluster(cl)
    
  } else {
    # Sequential processing
    cat("  - Using sequential processing\n")
    
    n_attempts <- ifelse(preserve_erepro, n_sims, ceiling(n_sims * 2))
    results <- list()
    
    for(i in 1:n_attempts) {
      if(i %% 5 == 0) cat("    Processing simulation", i, "of", n_attempts, "\n")
      
      results[[i]] <- run_enhanced_single_sim(i, params, catchability_sd, abundance_sd,
                                             marine_mammal_species, effort_scen, 
                                             enhanced_steady_tol, enhanced_steady_t_max,
                                             spinup_years, spinup_multiplier,
                                             t_start, sim_years,
                                             preserve_erepro, max_erepro,
                                             species_weights_df, yield_obs_data,
                                             verbose = (i <= 3))  # Verbose for first 3 simulations
    }
  }
  
  # Process results
  sim_results <- list()
  param_combinations <- list()
  performance_results <- list()
  failed_sims <- list()
  successful_count <- 0
  full_results_for_sensitivity <- list()  # NEW: Store full results for sensitivity analysis
  
  for(res in results) {
    if(!is.null(res) && !inherits(res, "error")) {
      if(res$success) {
        successful_count <- successful_count + 1
        if(successful_count <= n_sims) {
          sim_results[[successful_count]] <- res$simulation
          param_combinations[[successful_count]] <- res$params_info
          performance_results[[successful_count]] <- res$performance
          full_results_for_sensitivity[[successful_count]] <- res  # NEW: Store full result for sensitivity
        }
      } else {
        failed_sims[[length(failed_sims) + 1]] <- res
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Final summary
  cat("\n=== ENHANCED SIMULATION RESULTS ===\n")
  cat("Completed", min(successful_count, n_sims), "successful simulations\n")
  if (length(failed_sims) > 0) {
    failure_reasons <- table(sapply(failed_sims, function(x) x$reason))
    cat("Failed simulations by reason:\n")
    print(failure_reasons)
    
    # Show detailed failure information for first few failures
    cat("\nDetailed failure analysis (first 5 failures):\n")
    for (i in 1:min(5, length(failed_sims))) {
      fail_info <- failed_sims[[i]]
      cat("  Sim", fail_info$sim_id, "- Reason:", fail_info$reason)
      if (!is.null(fail_info$details)) {
        cat(" - Details:", fail_info$details)
      }
      cat("\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Calculate summary statistics of performance
  if (length(performance_results) > 0) {
    composite_scores <- sapply(performance_results, function(x) x$composite_score)
    rmse_scores <- sapply(performance_results, function(x) x$total_weighted_rmse)
    
    cat("\nPerformance Summary:\n")
    cat("  Composite Score - Mean:", round(mean(composite_scores), 4), 
        "Range:", round(min(composite_scores), 4), "-", round(max(composite_scores), 4), "\n")
    cat("  Weighted RMSE - Mean:", round(mean(rmse_scores), 4), 
        "Range:", round(min(rmse_scores), 4), "-", round(max(rmse_scores), 4), "\n")
  }
  
  # Trim to requested number of simulations
  if(length(sim_results) > n_sims) {
    sim_results <- sim_results[1:n_sims]
    param_combinations <- param_combinations[1:n_sims]
    performance_results <- performance_results[1:n_sims]
  }
  
  return(list(
    simulations = sim_results,
    parameters = param_combinations,
    performance = performance_results,
    failed = failed_sims,
    n_successful = length(sim_results),
    n_attempts = length(results)
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# 🎯 LHS-BASED ENHANCED UNCERTAINTY ANALYSIS (MAIN FUNCTION)
# ============================================================================
# Main function to run LHS-based combined uncertainty simulations
run_lhs_enhanced_uncertainty_sims <- function(params,
                                             n_sims = 10,
                                             catchability_sd = 0.4,
                                             abundance_sd = 0.8,
                                             gamma_sd = 0.4,
                                             marine_mammal_species = NULL,
                                             effort_scen,
                                             enhanced_steady_tol = 0.002,
                                             enhanced_steady_t_max = 1000,
                                             spinup_years = 118,
                                             spinup_multiplier = 2,
                                             t_start = 1841,
                                             sim_years = 170,
                                             preserve_erepro = TRUE,
                                             max_erepro = 1,
                                             species_weights_df = species_weights,
                                             yield_obs_data,
                                             n_cores = NULL,
                                             parallel = TRUE,
                                             lhs_seed = 123,
                                             run_sensitivity_analysis = TRUE,
                                             progress_interval = 50,
                                             target_sims_estimate = 10000) {
  
  # Start timing the analysis
  analysis_start_time <- Sys.time()
  cat("🚀 Starting LHS uncertainty analysis at:", format(analysis_start_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")
  
  # Default marine mammal species if not specified
  if (is.null(marine_mammal_species)) {
    marine_mammal_species <- c("minke whales", "orca", "sperm whales", "baleen whales")
  }
  
  # Determine number of cores to use
  if (is.null(n_cores)) {
    n_cores <- detectCores() - 1
  }
  n_cores <- min(n_cores, detectCores())
  
  # ============================================================================
  # STEP 1: Generate LHS parameter combinations
  # ============================================================================
  cat("=== LHS-BASED ENHANCED COMBINED UNCERTAINTY ANALYSIS ===\n")
  cat("Generating", n_sims, "LHS parameter combinations...\n")
  
  lhs_params <- generate_lhs_parameters(n_sims = n_sims,
                                       catchability_sd = catchability_sd,
                                       abundance_sd = abundance_sd,
                                       gamma_sd = gamma_sd,
                                       marine_mammal_species = marine_mammal_species,
                                       params_object = params,
                                       seed = lhs_seed)
  
  cat("\nRunning", n_sims, "simulations with LHS-enhanced protocols:\n")
  cat("  - Steady-state tolerance:", enhanced_steady_tol, "\n")
  cat("  - Minimum steady-state time:", enhanced_steady_t_max, "years\n")
  cat("  - Spinup multiplier:", spinup_multiplier, "x (", spinup_years * spinup_multiplier, "years total)\n")
  cat("  - LHS parameter space filling: ENABLED\n")
  cat("  - Whale species weighting: Applied to performance metrics\n")
  cat("  - Performance metrics: RMSE, MAE, Bias, Correlation, Composite Score\n")
  
  if (preserve_erepro) {
    cat("  - Preserving erepro values during steady state\n")
  } else {
    cat("  - Will skip simulations with erepro >", max_erepro, "\n")
  }
  
  # ============================================================================
  # STEP 2: Run simulations with LHS parameters
  # ============================================================================
  if (parallel && n_cores > 1) {
    cat("  - Using parallel processing with", n_cores, "cores\n")
    
    # Set up parallel cluster
    cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)
    registerDoParallel(cl)
    
    # Export necessary objects to cluster
    clusterExport(cl, c("run_lhs_enhanced_single_sim", "apply_lhs_parameters",
                       "enhanced_steady_state", "enhanced_spinup", 
                       "check_biomass_stability_enhanced",
                       "calculate_enhanced_performance_metrics",
                       "species_weights_df", "lhs_params"), 
                  envir = environment())
    
    # Export yield data for any legacy references in cluster functions
    clusterExport(cl, "yield_obs_data", envir = environment())
    
    # Also create yield_ts_tidy alias in cluster environment for backward compatibility
    clusterEvalQ(cl, {
      yield_ts_tidy <- yield_obs_data
    })
    
    cat("  - Running", n_sims, "LHS simulations in parallel...\n")
    
    results <- foreach(i = 1:n_sims,
                      .packages = c("mizer", "therMizer", "dplyr"),
                      .errorhandling = "pass") %dopar% {
      run_lhs_enhanced_single_sim(i, params, lhs_params,
                                 marine_mammal_species, effort_scen, 
                                 enhanced_steady_tol, enhanced_steady_t_max,
                                 spinup_years, spinup_multiplier,
                                 t_start, sim_years,
                                 preserve_erepro, max_erepro,
                                 species_weights_df, yield_obs_data)
    }
    
    # Stop cluster
    stopCluster(cl)
    
  } else {
    # Sequential processing
    cat("  - Using sequential processing with time tracking\n")
    
    results <- list()
    
    for(i in 1:n_sims) {
      # Print progress update at specified intervals
      if(i %% progress_interval == 0 || i == 1 || i == n_sims) {
        print_progress_update(i, n_sims, analysis_start_time, target_sims_estimate)
      } else if(i %% 10 == 0) {
        cat("    Processing LHS simulation", i, "of", n_sims, 
            sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", (i/n_sims)*100))
      }
      
      results[[i]] <- run_lhs_enhanced_single_sim(i, params, lhs_params,
                                                 marine_mammal_species, effort_scen, 
                                                 enhanced_steady_tol, enhanced_steady_t_max,
                                                 spinup_years, spinup_multiplier,
                                                 t_start, sim_years,
                                                 preserve_erepro, max_erepro,
                                                 species_weights_df, yield_obs_data,
                                                 verbose = (i <= 3))  # Verbose for first 3 simulations
    }
  }
  
  # ============================================================================
  # STEP 3: Process results and provide enhanced diagnostics
  # ============================================================================
  sim_results <- list()
  param_combinations <- list()
  performance_results <- list()
  failed_sims <- list()
  successful_count <- 0
  full_results_for_sensitivity <- list()  # NEW: Store full results for sensitivity analysis
  
  for(res in results) {
    if(!is.null(res) && !inherits(res, "error")) {
      if(res$success) {
        successful_count <- successful_count + 1
        sim_results[[successful_count]] <- res$simulation
        param_combinations[[successful_count]] <- res$params_info
        performance_results[[successful_count]] <- res$performance
        full_results_for_sensitivity[[successful_count]] <- res  # NEW: Store full result for sensitivity
      } else {
        failed_sims[[length(failed_sims) + 1]] <- res
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Final summary with LHS-specific diagnostics
  cat("\n=== LHS ENHANCED SIMULATION RESULTS ===\n")
  cat("Completed", successful_count, "successful simulations out of", n_sims, "requested\n")
  success_rate <- (successful_count / n_sims) * 100
  cat("Success rate:", round(success_rate, 1), "%\n")
  
  if (length(failed_sims) > 0) {
    failure_reasons <- table(sapply(failed_sims, function(x) x$reason))
    cat("Failed simulations by reason:\n")
    print(failure_reasons)
    
    # Show detailed failure information for first few failures
    cat("\nDetailed failure analysis (first 5 failures):\n")
    for (i in 1:min(5, length(failed_sims))) {
      fail_info <- failed_sims[[i]]
      cat("  Sim", fail_info$sim_id, "- Reason:", fail_info$reason)
      if (!is.null(fail_info$details)) {
        cat(" - Details:", fail_info$details)
      }
      cat("\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Calculate summary statistics of performance
  if (length(performance_results) > 0) {
    composite_scores <- sapply(performance_results, function(x) x$composite_score)
    rmse_scores <- sapply(performance_results, function(x) x$total_weighted_rmse)
    
    cat("\nLHS Performance Summary:\n")
    cat("  Composite Score - Mean:", round(mean(composite_scores), 4), 
        "Range:", round(min(composite_scores), 4), "-", round(max(composite_scores), 4), "\n")
    cat("  Weighted RMSE - Mean:", round(mean(rmse_scores), 4), 
        "Range:", round(min(rmse_scores), 4), "-", round(max(rmse_scores), 4), "\n")
    
    # LHS-specific quality metrics
    cat("\nLHS Space-Filling Quality:\n")
    if (successful_count > 1) {
      # Extract parameter combinations for correlation analysis
      all_catch_factors <- do.call(rbind, lapply(param_combinations, function(x) x$catchability_factors))
      all_abund_factors <- do.call(rbind, lapply(param_combinations, function(x) x$marine_mammal_scaling))
      all_params <- cbind(all_catch_factors, all_abund_factors)
      
      param_correlations <- cor(all_params)
      max_off_diagonal_corr <- max(abs(param_correlations[upper.tri(param_correlations)]))
      cat("  Maximum parameter correlation:", round(max_off_diagonal_corr, 3), 
          "(lower indicates better space-filling)\n")
      
      # Coverage assessment
      coverage_ranges <- apply(all_params, 2, function(x) max(x) / min(x))
      cat("  Parameter range coverage (max/min ratios):\n")
      cat("    Mean:", round(mean(coverage_ranges), 1), "x\n")
      cat("    Range:", round(min(coverage_ranges), 1), "-", round(max(coverage_ranges), 1), "x\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Run sensitivity analysis if requested
  sensitivity_results <- NULL
  if (run_sensitivity_analysis && length(full_results_for_sensitivity) >= 10) {
    cat("\n=== RUNNING SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS ===\n")
    sensitivity_results <- run_comprehensive_sensitivity_analysis(full_results_for_sensitivity, lhs_params, marine_mammal_species)
    cat("Sensitivity analysis completed successfully\n")
  } else if (run_sensitivity_analysis) {
    cat("\nWarning: Sensitivity analysis skipped - need at least 10 successful simulations\n")
  }

  # Final timing information
  analysis_end_time <- Sys.time()
  total_analysis_time <- as.numeric(difftime(analysis_end_time, analysis_start_time, units = "secs"))
  
  cat("\n🏁 ANALYSIS COMPLETED!\n")
  cat("⏱️  Total analysis time:", format_duration(total_analysis_time), "\n")
  cat("🚀 Average time per simulation:", format_duration(total_analysis_time / n_sims), "\n")
  
  if (length(sim_results) > 0) {
    actual_rate <- length(sim_results) / total_analysis_time * 3600  # sims per hour
    cat("📊 Successful simulation rate:", round(actual_rate, 1), "sims/hour\n")
    
    # Estimate for 10,000 simulations
    time_for_10k <- 10000 / (length(sim_results) / total_analysis_time)
    cat("🎯 Estimated time for 10,000 simulations:", format_duration(time_for_10k), "\n")
    
    # Calculate efficiency
    efficiency <- (length(sim_results) / n_sims) * 100
    cat("✅ Success rate:", round(efficiency, 1), "%\n")
  }
  
  cat("📝 Analysis completed at:", format(analysis_end_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")

  return(list(
    simulations = sim_results,
    parameters = param_combinations,
    performance = performance_results,
    lhs_design = lhs_params,
    sensitivity = sensitivity_results,
    failed = failed_sims,
    n_successful = length(sim_results),
    n_requested = n_sims,
    success_rate = success_rate,
    method = "Latin_Hypercube_Sampling",
    timing = list(
      start_time = analysis_start_time,
      end_time = analysis_end_time,
      total_duration = total_analysis_time,
      avg_time_per_sim = total_analysis_time / n_sims,
      successful_rate_per_hour = if(length(sim_results) > 0) length(sim_results) / total_analysis_time * 3600 else 0,
      estimated_time_10k = if(length(sim_results) > 0) 10000 / (length(sim_results) / total_analysis_time) else NA
    )
  ))
}

# Function to find optimal parameters based on enhanced metrics
find_optimal_parameters_enhanced <- function(sim_results_list, metric = "composite_score") {
  
  # Extract performance metrics
  performance_data <- sim_results_list$performance
  
  if (length(performance_data) == 0) {
    stop("No performance data available")
  }
  
  # Debug: Show available metrics from first performance entry
  if (length(performance_data) > 0) {
    available_metrics <- names(performance_data[[1]])
    cat("Available metrics:", paste(available_metrics, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  
  # Get the specified metric values
  metric_values <- sapply(performance_data, function(x) {
    if (metric %in% names(x)) {
      return(x[[metric]])
    } else {
      return(NA)
    }
  })
  
  # Debug: Show how many valid values we found
  valid_values <- sum(!is.na(metric_values))
  cat("Found", valid_values, "valid values for metric:", metric, "\n")
  
  if (valid_values == 0) {
    stop("Could not find any valid values for metric: ", metric)
  }
  
  # Find optimal (minimum for most metrics)
  if (metric == "avg_correlation") {
    optimal_idx <- which.max(metric_values)  # Higher correlation is better
  } else {
    optimal_idx <- which.min(metric_values)  # Lower is better for RMSE, MAE, bias, composite
  }
  
  if (length(optimal_idx) == 0 || is.na(optimal_idx) || is.na(metric_values[optimal_idx])) {
    cat("Debug info:\n")
    cat("  metric_values length:", length(metric_values), "\n")
    cat("  valid values:", sum(!is.na(metric_values)), "\n")
    cat("  metric_values range:", range(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    stop("Could not find optimal simulation for metric: ", metric)
  }
  
  # Create summary statistics
  metric_stats <- data.frame(
    mean = mean(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(metric_values, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(metric_values, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  cat("\n=== OPTIMAL PARAMETER SELECTION ===\n")
  cat("Optimization metric:", metric, "\n")
  cat("Optimal simulation:", optimal_idx, "with", metric, "=", metric_values[optimal_idx], "\n")
  cat("\nMetric Statistics:\n")
  print(metric_stats)
  
  # Extract detailed performance for optimal simulation
  optimal_performance <- performance_data[[optimal_idx]]
  
  cat("\n=== OPTIMAL SIMULATION PERFORMANCE ===\n")
  cat("Weighted RMSE:", round(optimal_performance$total_weighted_rmse, 4), "\n")
  cat("Weighted MAE:", round(optimal_performance$total_weighted_mae, 4), "\n")
  cat("Weighted Bias:", round(optimal_performance$total_weighted_bias, 4), "\n")
  cat("Average Correlation:", round(optimal_performance$avg_correlation, 4), "\n")
  cat("Composite Score:", round(optimal_performance$composite_score, 4), "\n")
  
  cat("\nSpecies-specific performance:\n")
  print(optimal_performance$metrics_by_species)
  
  return(list(
    optimal_index = optimal_idx,
    optimal_metric_value = metric_values[optimal_idx],
    optimal_sim = sim_results_list$simulations[[optimal_idx]],
    optimal_params = sim_results_list$parameters[[optimal_idx]],
    optimal_performance = optimal_performance,
    all_metric_values = metric_values,
    metric_stats = metric_stats,
    metric_used = metric
  ))
}

# Function to plot RMSE distribution from uncertainty analysis
plot_rmse_distribution <- function(rmse_values,
                                  optimal_idx = NULL,
                                  plot_title = "RMSE Distribution from Combined Parameter Uncertainty") {
  
  require(ggplot2)
  
  df <- data.frame(
    Simulation = 1:length(rmse_values),
    RMSE = rmse_values
  )
  
  # Calculate statistics for annotation
  mean_rmse <- mean(rmse_values)
  median_rmse <- median(rmse_values)
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = RMSE)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      subtitle = paste("n =", length(rmse_values), "simulations"),
      x = "RMSE (Root Mean Square Error)",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    # Add mean line
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean_rmse,
              color = "blue", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
    # Add median line
    geom_vline(xintercept = median_rmse,
              color = "green", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1)
  
  # Add vertical line for optimal value if provided
  if (!is.null(optimal_idx)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_vline(xintercept = rmse_values[optimal_idx],
                color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
      annotate("text",
              x = rmse_values[optimal_idx],
              y = max(table(cut(rmse_values, 30))) * 0.9,
              label = paste("Optimal RMSE =", round(rmse_values[optimal_idx], 2)),
              hjust = -0.1, color = "red")
  }
  
  # Add legend for lines
  p <- p +
    annotate("text", x = mean_rmse, y = max(table(cut(rmse_values, 30))) * 0.8,
            label = paste("Mean =", round(mean_rmse, 2)),
            hjust = -0.1, color = "blue", size = 3) +
    annotate("text", x = median_rmse, y = max(table(cut(rmse_values, 30))) * 0.7,
            label = paste("Median =", round(median_rmse, 2)),
            hjust = -0.1, color = "green", size = 3)
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to visualize parameter combinations
plot_parameter_exploration <- function(param_combinations, rmse_values) {
  
  require(ggplot2)
  require(tidyr)
  require(dplyr)
  
  # Extract catchability and marine mammal scaling
  df_params <- data.frame(
    sim_id = 1:length(param_combinations),
    rmse = rmse_values
  )
  
  # Add catchability info (assuming single gear for simplicity)
  df_params$catchability <- sapply(param_combinations, function(x) mean(x$catchability))
  
  # Add marine mammal scaling (mean across all marine mammals)
  df_params$mammal_scaling <- sapply(param_combinations, function(x) mean(x$marine_mammal_scaling))
  
  # Create scatter plot
  p1 <- ggplot(df_params, aes(x = catchability, y = mammal_scaling, color = rmse)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", name = "RMSE") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = "Parameter Space Exploration",
      x = "Mean Catchability",
      y = "Mean Marine Mammal Scaling Factor"
    )
  
  # Create individual parameter distributions
  p2 <- ggplot(df_params, aes(x = catchability)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = "Catchability Distribution", x = "Catchability", y = "Count")
  
  p3 <- ggplot(df_params, aes(x = mammal_scaling)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = "Marine Mammal Scaling Distribution", x = "Scaling Factor", y = "Count")
  
  # Combine plots
  require(gridExtra)
  combined_plot <- grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
  
  return(combined_plot)
}
```
