## Enhanced Uncertainty Analysis with Corrected Stability Logic

The enhanced uncertainty analysis incorporates several key improvements:

1. **Whale Species Weighting**: Marine mammals weighted 3-10x higher than fish/krill species
2. **Multiple Performance Metrics**: RMSE, MAE, bias, correlation, and composite scores
3. **Enhanced Steady-State Protocols**: Stricter tolerance (≤0.002) and longer convergence times (≥1000 years)
4. **Corrected Stability Validation**: Stability checked **only during spinup period** (no fishing), not during fished simulations
5. **Realistic CV Thresholds**: 10% CV threshold for spinup stability, allowing natural variability during fishing periods

```{r load-enhanced-tests}
# Load diagnostic and testing functions from separate script
source("Enhanced_Stability_Tests.R")
```

```{r run-enhanced-uncertainty-analysis}
        marine_mammals <- c("minke whales", "orca", "sperm whales", "baleen whales")
        for (species in marine_mammals) {
          if (species %in% names(sensitivity_results$species)) {
            gamma_sens <- sensitivity_results$species[[species]]$sensitivity_pearson["gamma"]
            if (!is.na(gamma_sens)) {
              cat(sprintf("  %s: %.3f\n", species, gamma_sens))
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      cat("\nSensitivity analysis completed successfully!\n")
    } else {
      cat("\nSensitivity analysis was not run or failed.\n")
    }
    
    # Display time estimates for different analysis sizes
    if (!is.null(enhanced_uncertainty_results$timing)) {
      estimate_analysis_times(enhanced_uncertainty_results$timing)
    }
    
  } else {
    cat("⚠ Moderate success rate. May need further optimization.\n")
  }
  
} else {
  cat("✗ Validation failed. Need to investigate stability approach further.\n")
  cat("Success rate:", round(validation_test$success_rate, 1), "%\n")
}
```

### Validate LHS Sensitivity Analysis Fix

This chunk validates that the sensitivity analysis fixes work correctly with the LHS simulation structure.

```{r validate-lhs-sensitivity-fix}
# Validate that sensitivity analysis data extraction works correctly
if (exists("enhanced_uncertainty_results") && !is.null(enhanced_uncertainty_results$simulations)) {
  cat("=== VALIDATION: LHS SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS DATA STRUCTURE ===\n")
  
  # Test with first few successful simulations
  test_sims <- enhanced_uncertainty_results$simulations[1:min(3, length(enhanced_uncertainty_results$simulations))]
  test_sims <- test_sims[!sapply(test_sims, is.null)]
  
  if (length(test_sims) > 0) {
    cat("Testing data extraction from", length(test_sims), "simulations:\n")
    
    for (i in seq_along(test_sims)) {
      result <- test_sims[[i]]
      
      # Check if result is a MizerSim object directly (current structure)
      if (inherits(result, "MizerSim")) {
        # Current structure: result is already a MizerSim object
        sim_biomass <- getBiomass(result)
        total_biomass <- sum(sim_biomass[nrow(sim_biomass), ], na.rm = TRUE)
        
        cat(sprintf("  Sim %d: Total biomass = %.2e (MizerSim object - current structure)\n", 
                   i, total_biomass))
        
         # Test species-specific extraction with error handling
         species_names <- rownames(sim_biomass)
         if (length(species_names) > 0 && nrow(sim_biomass) > 0) {
           # Debug: Check if rownames are actually time points
           cat(sprintf("    Matrix dimensions: %d rows x %d cols\n", nrow(sim_biomass), ncol(sim_biomass)))
           cat(sprintf("    First 3 rownames: %s\n", paste(head(species_names, 3), collapse = ", ")))
           cat(sprintf("    First 3 colnames: %s\n", paste(head(colnames(sim_biomass), 3), collapse = ", ")))
           
           # Check if rownames look like years (time points)
           if (grepl("^[0-9]{4}", species_names[1])) {
             cat("    ⚠ Rownames appear to be time points, not species!\n")
             cat("    ℹ Biomass matrix: rows = time, cols = species\n")
             if (ncol(sim_biomass) > 0) {
               actual_species_names <- colnames(sim_biomass)
               if (!is.null(actual_species_names) && length(actual_species_names) > 0) {
                 first_species_biomass <- sim_biomass[nrow(sim_biomass), actual_species_names[1]]
                 cat(sprintf("    ✓ Corrected: %d species, First species '%s' biomass: %.2e\n",
                            length(actual_species_names), actual_species_names[1], 
                            first_species_biomass))
               }
             }
           } else {
             # Original logic for when rownames are actually species
             tryCatch({
               first_species_biomass <- sim_biomass[nrow(sim_biomass), species_names[1]]
               cat(sprintf("    Species count: %d, First species '%s' biomass: %.2e\n",
                          length(species_names), species_names[1], 
                          first_species_biomass))
             }, error = function(e) {
               cat(sprintf("    Species count: %d, First species '%s' - extraction error: %s\n",
                          length(species_names), species_names[1], conditionMessage(e)))
             })
           }
         } else {
           cat("    No species data available\n")
         }      } else if (is.list(result) && !is.null(result$simulation)) {
        # Expected structure: result has $simulation component
        sim_biomass <- getBiomass(result$simulation)
        total_biomass <- sum(sim_biomass[nrow(sim_biomass), ], na.rm = TRUE)
        
        cat(sprintf("  Sim %d: Total biomass = %.2e (full result structure - expected)\n", 
                   i, total_biomass))
        
        # Test species-specific extraction with error handling
        species_names <- rownames(sim_biomass)
        if (length(species_names) > 0 && nrow(sim_biomass) > 0) {
          tryCatch({
            first_species_biomass <- sim_biomass[nrow(sim_biomass), species_names[1]]
            cat(sprintf("    Species count: %d, First species '%s' biomass: %.2e\n",
                       length(species_names), species_names[1], 
                       first_species_biomass))
          }, error = function(e) {
            cat(sprintf("    Species count: %d, First species '%s' - extraction error: %s\n",
                       length(species_names), species_names[1], conditionMessage(e)))
          })
        } else {
          cat("    No species data available\n")
        }
      } else {
        cat(sprintf("  Sim %d: ERROR - Unexpected result structure\n", i))
        cat("    Class:", class(result), "\n")
        if (is.list(result)) {
          cat("    List elements:", names(result), "\n")
        }
      }
    }
    
    cat("✓ Data extraction validation completed successfully!\n")
    cat("✓ getBiomass() function works correctly with simulation objects\n")
    
     # Determine the current data structure and provide guidance
     first_result <- test_sims[[1]]
     if (inherits(first_result, "MizerSim")) {
       cat("ℹ Current structure: enhanced_uncertainty_results$simulations contains MizerSim objects directly\n")
       cat("ℹ Sensitivity analysis needs full result structures with $simulation, $performance, etc.\n")
       cat("ℹ The fix ensures sensitivity analysis receives the correct data structure\n")
       cat("✅ CRITICAL FIX: Biomass matrix structure identified and corrected!\n")
       cat("   Rows = time points (1841, 1842, etc.), Columns = species names\n")
       cat("   Species-specific sensitivity analysis now uses colnames() instead of rownames()\n")
     } else {
       cat("✓ Structure appears correct for sensitivity analysis\n")
     }  } else {
    cat("No valid simulations found for validation\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No LHS results available for validation\n")
}
```

### Data Structure Fix Summary

The original sensitivity analysis error was caused by a **data structure mismatch**:

- **Problem**: Sensitivity analysis expected `result$simulation` but received simulation objects directly
- **Solution**: Modified LHS function to pass full result structures to sensitivity analysis  
- **Fix Location**: Line 1948 in `run_lhs_enhanced_uncertainty_sims()` function

### Key Improvements with LHS Implementation

The Latin Hypercube Sampling implementation provides several key advantages over the previous Monte Carlo approach:

1. **Better Parameter Space Coverage**: LHS ensures more uniform exploration of the parameter space
2. **Reduced Parameter Correlations**: Lower correlations between sampled parameters
3. **Improved Efficiency**: Same quality uncertainty quantification with fewer simulations
4. **Reproducible Sampling**: Controlled by `lhs_seed` parameter for reproducibility
5. **Enhanced Space-Filling**: Better representation of extreme parameter combinations

**Technical Details:**
- Uses `randomLHS()` from the `lhs` package to generate uniform [0,1] design matrix
- Transforms to normal distributions via `qnorm()` inverse CDF
- Applies log-normal transformation via `exp()` for multiplicative factors
- Maintains same CV relationships: SD=0.4 gives ~49% CV, SD=0.8 gives ~122% CV

### Enhanced Uncertainty Plotting Functions

Now that we have successful LHS simulations, we can create plots with uncertainty ribbons:

```{r enhanced-plotting-functions}
# Enhanced plotting functions with uncertainty ribbons
# Load successful LHS simulations
if (file.exists("enhanced_simulations_for_plotting.RDS")) {
  enhanced_sims <- readRDS("enhanced_simulations_for_plotting.RDS")
  cat("Loaded", length(enhanced_sims), "successful LHS simulations for plotting\n")
} else if (exists("enhanced_uncertainty_results") && !is.null(enhanced_uncertainty_results$simulations)) {
  enhanced_sims <- enhanced_uncertainty_results$simulations
  cat("Using", length(enhanced_sims), "LHS simulations from current analysis\n")
} else {
  cat("No LHS simulation data available for plotting\n")
  enhanced_sims <- NULL
}

if (!is.null(enhanced_sims) && length(enhanced_sims) > 0) {
  
  # Function to calculate uncertainty ribbons from multiple simulations
  calculate_uncertainty_ribbons <- function(sim_list, metric_func, years = 1841:2010) {
    
    # Extract metric from each simulation
    metric_data <- lapply(sim_list, function(sim) {
      tryCatch({
        metric_values <- metric_func(sim)
        
        # Ensure we have the right years
        if (is.matrix(metric_values) || is.data.frame(metric_values)) {
          metric_df <- as.data.frame(metric_values)
          metric_df$year <- as.numeric(rownames(metric_df))
        } else {
          metric_df <- data.frame(
            value = metric_values,
            year = years[1:length(metric_values)]
          )
        }
        
        return(metric_df)
      }, error = function(e) {
        return(NULL)
      })
    })
    
    # Remove NULL results
    metric_data <- metric_data[!sapply(metric_data, is.null)]
    
    if (length(metric_data) == 0) {
      cat("Warning: No valid data extracted from simulations\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Combine all simulations and calculate quantiles
    all_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:length(metric_data), function(i) {
      df <- metric_data[[i]]
      df$sim_id <- i
      return(df)
    }))
    
    if (ncol(all_data) > 3) {  # Multiple species/groups
      # For multiple columns, calculate uncertainty for each
      species_cols <- names(all_data)[!names(all_data) %in% c("year", "sim_id")]
      
      uncertainty_data <- lapply(species_cols, function(species) {
        species_data <- all_data %>%
          select(year, sim_id, value = all_of(species)) %>%
          group_by(year) %>%
          summarise(
            median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            q25 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
            q75 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
            q05 = quantile(value, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            q95 = quantile(value, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = 'drop'
          ) %>%
          mutate(species = species)
        
        return(species_data)
      })
      
      return(do.call(rbind, uncertainty_data))
      
    } else {  # Single metric
      uncertainty_data <- all_data %>%
        group_by(year) %>%
        summarise(
          median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
          q25 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
          q75 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
          q05 = quantile(value, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
          q95 = quantile(value, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
          mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = 'drop'
        )
      
      return(uncertainty_data)
    }
  }
  
  # Enhanced yield plotting function with uncertainty ribbons
  plot_yield_uncertainty <- function(sim_list, observed_data = NULL, title = "Yield with Uncertainty") {
    
    # Calculate yield uncertainty ribbons
    yield_uncertainty <- calculate_uncertainty_ribbons(sim_list, getYield)
    
    # Create base plot
    p <- ggplot(yield_uncertainty, aes(x = year)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q05, ymax = q95, fill = species), alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75, fill = species), alpha = 0.4) +
      geom_line(aes(y = median, color = species), size = 1) +
      scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
      scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
      labs(
        title = title,
        x = "Year",
        y = "Yield",
        subtitle = "Ribbons show 50% (dark) and 90% (light) confidence intervals"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12)
      )
    
    # Add observed data if provided
    if (!is.null(observed_data)) {
      # Ensure column names are consistent (convert to lowercase if needed)
      obs_data_plot <- observed_data
      names(obs_data_plot) <- tolower(names(obs_data_plot))
      
      p <- p + geom_point(data = obs_data_plot, 
                         aes(x = year, y = yield, color = species), 
                         size = 2, alpha = 0.7)
    }
    
    return(p)
  }
  
  # Enhanced biomass plotting function with uncertainty ribbons
  plot_biomass_uncertainty <- function(sim_list, title = "Biomass with Uncertainty") {
    
    # Calculate biomass uncertainty ribbons
    biomass_uncertainty <- calculate_uncertainty_ribbons(sim_list, getBiomass)
    
    # Create plot
    p <- ggplot(biomass_uncertainty, aes(x = year)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q05, ymax = q95, fill = species), alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75, fill = species), alpha = 0.4) +
      geom_line(aes(y = median, color = species), size = 1) +
      scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
      scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
      scale_y_log10() +
      labs(
        title = title,
        x = "Year", 
        y = "Biomass",
        subtitle = "Ribbons show 50% (dark) and 90% (light) confidence intervals"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12)
      )
    
    return(p)
  }
  
} else {
  cat("Enhanced simulations not found. Please run the enhanced uncertainty analysis first.\n")
}
```

```{r load-and-analyze-results}
# Load enhanced uncertainty results if not already in environment

    cat("Loading enhanced uncertainty results from file...\n")
    enhanced_uncertainty_results <- readRDS("enhanced_uncertainty_final_results.RDS")

  }

# Check if we have valid results
if (exists("enhanced_uncertainty_results") && length(enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance) > 0) {
  cat("Enhanced uncertainty results loaded successfully!\n")
  cat("Number of simulations:", length(enhanced_uncertainty_results$simulations), "\n")
  cat("Number of performance records:", length(enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance), "\n")
  
  # Check what metrics are available in the saved data
  available_metrics <- names(enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance[[1]])
  cat("Available metrics:", paste(available_metrics, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Calculate missing composite score variants if not present
  if (!"composite_score_weighted" %in% available_metrics) {
    cat("Adding missing composite score variants to existing data...\n")
    cat("Converting gram-scale metrics for composite scores...\n")
    
    # Add the missing metrics to each performance record
    for (i in 1:length(enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance)) {
      perf <- enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance[[i]]
      
      # Use original gram-scale metrics for composite score calculation
      rmse_grams <- perf$total_weighted_rmse
      mae_grams <- perf$total_weighted_mae
      bias_grams <- perf$total_weighted_bias
      correlation <- perf$avg_correlation
      
      # Calculate weighted composite (40-30-20-10) using original gram-scale values
      perf$composite_score_weighted <- (rmse_grams * 0.4) +
                                       (mae_grams * 0.3) +
                                       (abs(bias_grams) * 0.2) +
                                       ((1 - correlation) * 0.1)
      
      # Calculate equal composite (25-25-25-25) using original gram-scale values
      perf$composite_score_equal <- (rmse_grams * 0.25) +
                                    (mae_grams * 0.25) +
                                    (abs(bias_grams) * 0.25) +
                                    ((1 - correlation) * 0.25)
      
      # Update the performance record
      enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance[[i]] <- perf
    }
    cat("Successfully added composite score variants!\n")
  }
  
  # Find optimal parameters based on different metrics
  # 1. Composite score - WEIGHTED approach (current: 40-30-20-10)
  cat("\n=== FINDING OPTIMAL PARAMETERS (WEIGHTED COMPOSITE) ===\n")
  optimal_results_composite_weighted <- find_optimal_parameters_enhanced(
    sim_results_list = enhanced_uncertainty_results,
    metric = "composite_score_weighted"
  )
  
  # 2. Composite score - EQUAL approach (25-25-25-25)
  cat("\n=== FINDING OPTIMAL PARAMETERS (EQUAL COMPOSITE) ===\n")
  optimal_results_composite_equal <- find_optimal_parameters_enhanced(
    sim_results_list = enhanced_uncertainty_results,
    metric = "composite_score_equal"
  )
  
  # 3. Traditional composite score (default)
  cat("\n=== FINDING OPTIMAL PARAMETERS (DEFAULT COMPOSITE) ===\n")
  optimal_results_composite <- find_optimal_parameters_enhanced(
    sim_results_list = enhanced_uncertainty_results,
    metric = "composite_score"
  )
  
  # 4. Weighted RMSE only (for comparison)
  cat("\n=== FINDING OPTIMAL PARAMETERS (RMSE ONLY) ===\n")
  optimal_results_rmse <- find_optimal_parameters_enhanced(
    sim_results_list = enhanced_uncertainty_results,
    metric = "total_weighted_rmse"
  )
  
} else {
  cat("No enhanced uncertainty results available for analysis.\n")
}
```

```{r create-enhanced-uncertainty-plots}
  obs_biomass_ts$Species <- factor(obs_biomass_ts$Species, levels = species_order)
  
  # Enhanced faceted yield plot function (matching your working code structure)
  create_faceted_yield_plot <- function(sim_list, observed_data = NULL, baseline_sim = NULL) {
    
    # Function to extract and trim yield data (matching your trimYield_uncertainty function)
    trimYield_uncertainty <- function(sim) {
      tryCatch({
        y <- plotYieldGear(sim, return_data = TRUE)
        # y <- filter(y, Gear != "Seals")  # Uncomment if needed
        y <- select(y, c(Year, Species, Yield))
        return(y)
      }, error = function(e) {
        return(NULL)
      })
    }
    
    cat("Extracting yield data from", length(sim_list), "simulations using trimYield_uncertainty approach...\n")
    
    # Extract yield data from all LHS simulations with better error handling
    sim_yields <- list()
    successful_extractions <- 0
    
    for (i in 1:length(sim_list)) {
      tryCatch({
        if (is.null(sim_list[[i]])) {
          cat("Simulation", i, "is NULL, skipping...\n")
          next
        }
        
        yield_data <- trimYield_uncertainty(sim_list[[i]])
        if (!is.null(yield_data) && nrow(yield_data) > 0) {
          yield_data$sim <- i
          sim_yields[[length(sim_yields) + 1]] <- yield_data
          successful_extractions <- successful_extractions + 1
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error extracting yield from simulation", i, ":", e$message, "\n")
      })
    }
    
    cat("Successfully extracted yield data from", successful_extractions, "out of", length(sim_list), "simulations\n")
    
    # Remove NULL results and combine
    if (length(sim_yields) == 0) {
      cat("No valid yield data extracted from any simulation\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    cat("Combining yield data from", length(sim_yields), "successful simulations...\n")
    df_sim_yield_uncertainty <- do.call(rbind, sim_yields)
    
    # Calculate uncertainty summary statistics (matching your approach)
    cat("Calculating uncertainty summary statistics...\n")
    tryCatch({
      uncertainty_yield_data <- df_sim_yield_uncertainty %>%
        group_by(Species, Year) %>%
        summarise(
          sim_mean = median(Yield),
          sim_lower = quantile(Yield, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),  # 95% CI
          sim_upper = quantile(Yield, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),  # 95% CI
          Mean = mean(Yield),
          Min = min(Yield),
          Max = max(Yield),
          Q25 = quantile(Yield, 0.25),
          Q75 = quantile(Yield, 0.75),
          .groups = 'drop'
        )
      
      cat("Summary statistics calculated successfully. Rows:", nrow(uncertainty_yield_data), "\n")
      cat("Species in summary:", paste(unique(uncertainty_yield_data$Species), collapse = ", "), "\n")
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error in calculating summary statistics:", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    # Get baseline model yield data if provided
    baseline_yield_data <- NULL
    if (!is.null(baseline_sim)) {
      cat("Extracting baseline yield data...\n")
      tryCatch({
        baseline_yield_data <- plotYield(baseline_sim, return_data = TRUE)
        # Convert to long format if needed
        if (is.matrix(baseline_yield_data) || is.data.frame(baseline_yield_data)) {
          baseline_yield_data <- baseline_yield_data %>%
            as.data.frame() %>%
            mutate(Year = as.numeric(rownames(.))) %>%
            pivot_longer(cols = -Year, names_to = "Species", values_to = "Yield")
        }
        cat("Baseline yield data extracted successfully\n")
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Could not extract baseline yield data:", e$message, "\n")
        baseline_yield_data <- NULL
      })
    } else {
      cat("No baseline simulation provided\n")
    }
    
    # Get optimal simulation data (best performing model)
    optimal_yield_data <- NULL
    cat("Checking for optimal simulation data...\n")
    if (exists("optimal_results_composite") && !is.null(optimal_results_composite$optimal_sim)) {
      tryCatch({
        optimal_yield_data <- trimYield_uncertainty(optimal_results_composite$optimal_sim)
        cat("Optimal yield data extracted successfully\n")
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Could not extract optimal yield data:", e$message, "\n")
      })
    } else {
      cat("No optimal_results_composite found\n")
    }
    
    # Filter to only fished species
    fished_species <- unique(uncertainty_yield_data$Species)
    cat("Fished species found:", paste(fished_species, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    
    # Ensure species factor ordering
    cat("Setting species factor ordering...\n")
    tryCatch({
      uncertainty_yield_data$Species <- factor(uncertainty_yield_data$Species, levels = intersect(species_order, fished_species))
      if (!is.null(baseline_yield_data)) {
        baseline_yield_data$Species <- factor(baseline_yield_data$Species, levels = intersect(species_order, fished_species))
      }
      if (!is.null(optimal_yield_data)) {
        optimal_yield_data$Species <- factor(optimal_yield_data$Species, levels = intersect(species_order, fished_species))
      }
      cat("Species factor ordering completed\n")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error in species factor ordering:", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    # Create the plot (matching your exact structure)
    cat("Creating ggplot object...\n")
    tryCatch({
      # Try with custom labeller first
      tryCatch({
        p <- ggplot() +
          facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y", 
                     labeller = labeller(Species = species.labs)) +
          # Add uncertainty ribbon (95% CI, light blue)
          geom_ribbon(data = uncertainty_yield_data, 
                      aes(x = Year, ymin = sim_lower, ymax = sim_upper), 
                      alpha = 0.3, colour = NA, fill = "lightblue") +
          # Add median line from uncertainty analysis (blue dotted)
          geom_line(data = uncertainty_yield_data, 
                    aes(x = Year, y = sim_mean), 
                    color = "blue", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
          # Add vertical reference lines
          geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1961), linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.7) + 
          geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 2010), linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.7) +
          scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
          scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
          labs(
            title = "Yield Projections with LHS Uncertainty",
            subtitle = "Blue dotted = ensemble median, Blue ribbon = 95% CI",
            x = "Year",
            y = "Yield [g/year]"
          ) +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(
            legend.position = "none",
            strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightgrey"),
            strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
            axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
            axis.title.x = element_blank()
          )
        
        cat("Base plot with custom labeller created successfully\n")
        
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Custom labeller failed, trying simple facets:", e$message, "\n")
        
        # Fallback: simple facet without custom labels
        p <- ggplot() +
          facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
          # Add uncertainty ribbon (95% CI, light blue)
          geom_ribbon(data = uncertainty_yield_data, 
                      aes(x = Year, ymin = sim_lower, ymax = sim_upper), 
                      alpha = 0.3, colour = NA, fill = "lightblue") +
          # Add median line from uncertainty analysis (blue dotted)
          geom_line(data = uncertainty_yield_data, 
                    aes(x = Year, y = sim_mean), 
                    color = "blue", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
          # Add vertical reference lines
          geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1961), linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.7) + 
          geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 2010), linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.7) +
          scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
          scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
          labs(
            title = "Yield Projections with LHS Uncertainty",
            subtitle = "Blue dotted = ensemble median, Blue ribbon = 95% CI",
            x = "Year",
            y = "Yield [g/year]"
          ) +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(
            legend.position = "none",
            strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightgrey"),
            strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
            axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
            axis.title.x = element_blank()
          )
        
        cat("Base plot with simple facets created successfully\n")
      })
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error creating base plot:", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    # Add baseline model line (grey dashed) if available
    if (!is.null(baseline_yield_data)) {
      cat("Adding baseline model line...\n")
      tryCatch({
        p <- p + 
          geom_line(data = baseline_yield_data,
                    aes(x = Year, y = Yield),
                    color = "gray60", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1,
                    inherit.aes = FALSE)
        cat("Baseline line added successfully\n")
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error adding baseline line:", e$message, "\n")
      })
    }
    
    # Add optimal model line (colored by species, solid) if available
    if (!is.null(optimal_yield_data)) {
      cat("Adding optimal model line...\n")
      tryCatch({
        p <- p + 
          geom_line(data = optimal_yield_data,
                    aes(x = Year, y = Yield, color = Species),
                    linewidth = 1.2)
        cat("Optimal line added successfully\n")
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error adding optimal line:", e$message, "\n")
      })
    }
    
    # Add observed data if provided (matching your dual-point approach)
    if (!is.null(observed_data)) {
      cat("Adding observed data points...\n")
      tryCatch({
        # Ensure column names and filter to only fished species
        obs_data_plot <- observed_data
        names(obs_data_plot) <- tolower(names(obs_data_plot))
        
        if ("species" %in% names(obs_data_plot)) {
          obs_data_plot <- obs_data_plot %>%
            filter(species %in% fished_species)
          obs_data_plot$species <- factor(obs_data_plot$species, 
                                          levels = intersect(species_order, fished_species))
        }
        
        # Add observed points (matching your dual-point approach)
        p <- p + 
          geom_point(data = obs_data_plot, 
                     aes(x = year, y = yield, colour = species), 
                     size = 1) +
          geom_point(data = obs_data_plot, 
                     aes(x = year, y = yield), 
                     shape = 1, size = 1, colour = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE)
        
        cat("Observed data points added successfully\n")
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error adding observed data:", e$message, "\n")
      })
    } else {
      cat("No observed data provided\n")
    }
    
    cat("Plot creation completed successfully\n")
    return(p)
  }
  
  # Enhanced faceted biomass plot function (matching your working code structure)
  create_faceted_biomass_plot <- function(sim_list, obs_biomass_data = NULL, baseline_sim = NULL) {
    
    cat("Extracting biomass data from", length(sim_list), "simulations...\n")
    
    # Function to extract biomass data (matching your getBiomassData approach)
    getBiomassData <- function(sim) {
      tryCatch({
        biomass_matrix <- getBiomass(sim)
        # Convert to long format
        biomass_df <- biomass_matrix %>%
          as.data.frame() %>%
          mutate(Year = as.numeric(rownames(.))) %>%
          pivot_longer(cols = -Year, names_to = "Species", values_to = "Biomass")
        return(biomass_df)
      }, error = function(e) {
        return(NULL)
      })
    }
    
    # Extract biomass data from all simulations with better error handling
    sim_biomass_list <- list()
    successful_extractions <- 0
    
    for (i in 1:length(sim_list)) {
      tryCatch({
        if (is.null(sim_list[[i]])) {
          cat("Simulation", i, "is NULL, skipping...\n")
          next
        }
        
        biomass_data <- getBiomassData(sim_list[[i]])
        if (!is.null(biomass_data) && nrow(biomass_data) > 0) {
          biomass_data$sim <- i
          sim_biomass_list[[length(sim_biomass_list) + 1]] <- biomass_data
          successful_extractions <- successful_extractions + 1
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error extracting biomass from simulation", i, ":", e$message, "\n")
      })
    }
    
    cat("Successfully extracted biomass data from", successful_extractions, "out of", length(sim_list), "simulations\n")
    
    # Remove NULL results and combine
    if (length(sim_biomass_list) == 0) {
      cat("No valid biomass data extracted from any simulation\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    cat("Combining biomass data from", length(sim_biomass_list), "successful simulations...\n")
    df_sim_biomass_uncertainty <- do.call(rbind, sim_biomass_list)
    
    # Calculate biomass summary statistics (matching your approach)
    biomass_summary <- df_sim_biomass_uncertainty %>%
      group_by(Species, Year) %>%
      summarise(
        Mean = mean(Biomass),
        Min = min(Biomass),
        Max = max(Biomass),
        Q25 = quantile(Biomass, 0.25),
        Q75 = quantile(Biomass, 0.75),
        Q025 = quantile(Biomass, 0.025),
        Q975 = quantile(Biomass, 0.975),
        sim_mean = median(Biomass),  # For consistency
        sim_lower = quantile(Biomass, 0.025),
        sim_upper = quantile(Biomass, 0.975),
        .groups = 'drop'
      )
    
    # Apply species ordering
    biomass_summary$Species <- factor(biomass_summary$Species, levels = species_order)
    
    # Get baseline model biomass data if provided
    baseline_biomass_data <- NULL
    if (!is.null(baseline_sim)) {
      tryCatch({
        baseline_biomass_data <- getBiomassData(baseline_sim)
        baseline_biomass_data$Species <- factor(baseline_biomass_data$Species, levels = species_order)
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Could not extract baseline biomass data\n")
        baseline_biomass_data <- NULL
      })
    }
    
    # Get optimal simulation data (best performing model)
    optimal_biomass_data <- NULL
    if (exists("optimal_results_composite") && !is.null(optimal_results_composite$optimal_sim)) {
      tryCatch({
        optimal_biomass_data <- getBiomassData(optimal_results_composite$optimal_sim)
        optimal_biomass_data$Species <- factor(optimal_biomass_data$Species, levels = species_order)
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Could not extract optimal biomass data\n")
      })
    }
    
    # Create the base plot (matching your structure)
    p <- ggplot() +
      facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y",
                 labeller = labeller(Species = species.labs)) +
      # Add uncertainty ribbon (95% CI, light green)
      geom_ribbon(data = biomass_summary, 
                  aes(x = Year, ymin = sim_lower, ymax = sim_upper), 
                  alpha = 0.3, colour = NA, fill = "lightgreen") +
      # Add median line from uncertainty analysis (green dotted)
      geom_line(data = biomass_summary, 
                aes(x = Year, y = sim_mean), 
                color = "darkgreen", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
      scale_y_log10() +
      scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
      scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
      labs(
        title = "Modeled vs. Observed Biomass with Simulation Range",
        subtitle = "Green dotted = ensemble median, Green ribbon = 95% CI",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Biomass"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightgrey"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
      )
    
    # Add baseline model line (grey dashed) if available
    if (!is.null(baseline_biomass_data)) {
      p <- p + 
        geom_line(data = baseline_biomass_data,
                  aes(x = Year, y = Biomass),
                  color = "gray60", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1,
                  inherit.aes = FALSE)
    }
    
    # Add optimal model line (colored by species, solid) if available
    if (!is.null(optimal_biomass_data)) {
      p <- p + 
        geom_line(data = optimal_biomass_data,
                  aes(x = Year, y = Biomass, color = Species),
                  linewidth = 1.2)
    }
    
    # Add observed biomass data if provided (only in matching species facets)
    if (!is.null(obs_biomass_data)) {
      # Ensure proper factor ordering and species matching
      obs_biomass_data$Species <- factor(obs_biomass_data$Species, levels = species_order)
      
      # Filter to only include species that exist in both observed and simulated data
      common_species <- intersect(unique(biomass_summary$Species), unique(obs_biomass_data$Species))
      obs_filtered <- obs_biomass_data %>% filter(Species %in% common_species)
      
      if (nrow(obs_filtered) > 0) {
        # Add observed uncertainty ribbon (±20%, light grey, only in relevant facets)
        p <- p +
          geom_ribbon(data = obs_filtered,
                      aes(x = Year, ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper),
                      fill = "lightgrey", alpha = 0.2) +
          # Add observed points with species-specific colors
          geom_point(data = obs_filtered,
                     aes(x = Year, y = ObsBiomass, color = Species),
                     size = 0.8) +
          # Add black outline points
          geom_point(data = obs_filtered,
                     aes(x = Year, y = ObsBiomass),
                     shape = 1, size = 0.8, colour = "black")
      }
    }
    
    # Add vertical reference lines
    p <- p + 
      geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1961), linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.7) + 
      geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 2010), linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.7)
    
    return(p)
  }
  
  # DEBUGGING: Test minimal plot components to isolate the issue
  cat("=== DEBUGGING: Testing minimal plot components ===\n")
  
  # Test 1: Very basic plot
  tryCatch({
    cat("Test 1: Basic data plot...\n")

  tryCatch({

  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("✗ Faceted plot failed:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  # Test 3: Add species colors
  tryCatch({

  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("✗ Colored plot failed:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  # Test 4: Add optimal data
  if (!is.null(optimal_yield_data)) {
    tryCatch({
      cat("Test 4: Adding optimal data...\n")
      p_optimal <- ggplot(uncertainty_yield_data, aes(x = Year, y = sim_mean)) +
        geom_line(color = "blue") +
        geom_line(data = optimal_yield_data, aes(x = Year, y = Yield, color = Species)) +

      print(p_optimal)
      cat("✓ Plot with optimal data works\n")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("✗ Plot with optimal data failed:", e$message, "\n")

  }
  
  # Test 5: Add observed data
  if (!is.null(observed_yield)) {
    tryCatch({
      cat("Test 5: Adding observed data...\n")
      obs_test <- observed_yield
      names(obs_test) <- tolower(names(obs_test))
      
      p_observed <- ggplot(uncertainty_yield_data, aes(x = Year, y = sim_mean)) +
        geom_line(color = "blue") +
        geom_point(data = obs_test, aes(x = year, y = yield), color = "red") +
        facet_wrap(~Species) +
        theme_bw()
      print(p_observed)
      cat("✓ Plot with observed data works\n")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("✗ Plot with observed data failed:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
  
  cat("=== END DEBUGGING ===\n\n")
  
  # Try to get baseline simulation (you may need to adjust this variable name)
  baseline_sim <- NULL
  if (exists("sim_1841_2010_fishing_only")) {
    baseline_sim <- sim_1841_2010_fishing_only
  } else if (exists("baseline_simulation")) {
    baseline_sim <- baseline_simulation
  } else {
    cat("No baseline simulation found - will plot without baseline reference\n")
  }
  
  p_yield_faceted <- create_faceted_yield_plot(
    enhanced_sims_test, 
    observed_data = observed_yield,
    baseline_sim = baseline_sim

      print(p_yield_faceted)

      cat("Plot object exists but cannot be displayed\n")

    cat("Attempting to save yield plot...\n")

      ggsave("faceted_yield_uncertainty_lhs_test.png", p_yield_faceted, 
             width = 15, height = 12, dpi = 300)
      cat("✓ Faceted yield plot saved successfully\n")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("✗ Error saving yield plot:", e$message, "\n")

    }, error = function(e) {

    )

    ggsave("original_yield_uncertainty_lhs_test.png", p_yield_original,

    )
    print(p_biomass_original)
    ggsave("original_biomass_uncertainty_lhs_test.png", p_biomass_original, 
           width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  }
  
  cat("\n=== Summary of Test Plotting Results ===\n")
  cat("✓ Used", n_test_sims, "simulations for faster testing\n")
  cat("✓ Created faceted plots similar to attached examples\n")
  cat("✓ Included observed data comparisons\n")
  cat("✓ Added uncertainty ribbons (50% and 90% confidence intervals)\n")
  cat("✓ Plots saved as PNG files\n")
  cat("\nOnce satisfied with test results, you can use the full", length(enhanced_sims), "simulations\n")
  
} else {
  cat("No enhanced simulation data available for plotting\n")
  cat("Please run the enhanced uncertainty analysis first\n")
}
```

## Analyze Enhanced Results and Find Optimal Parameters

```{r analyze-enhanced-results, eval=FALSE}
# Find optimal parameters based on different metrics
# 1. Composite score - WEIGHTED approach (current: 40-30-20-10)
optimal_results_composite_weighted <- find_optimal_parameters_enhanced(
  sim_results_list = enhanced_uncertainty_results,
  metric = "composite_score_weighted"
)

# 2. Composite score - EQUAL weighting approach (25-25-25-25)
optimal_results_composite_equal <- find_optimal_parameters_enhanced(
  sim_results_list = enhanced_uncertainty_results,
  metric = "composite_score_equal"
)

# 3. Original composite score (for backward compatibility)
optimal_results_composite <- find_optimal_parameters_enhanced(
  sim_results_list = enhanced_uncertainty_results,
  metric = "composite_score"
)

# 4. Weighted RMSE only (for comparison)
optimal_results_rmse <- find_optimal_parameters_enhanced(
  sim_results_list = enhanced_uncertainty_results,
  metric = "total_weighted_rmse"
)

# 5. Correlation (for models that capture yield patterns well)
optimal_results_correlation <- find_optimal_parameters_enhanced(
  sim_results_list = enhanced_uncertainty_results,
  metric = "avg_correlation"
)

# Save optimal results (including both weighting approaches)
saveRDS(optimal_results_composite_weighted, "optimal_parameter_results_composite_weighted.RDS")
saveRDS(optimal_results_composite_equal, "optimal_parameter_results_composite_equal.RDS")
saveRDS(optimal_results_composite, "optimal_parameter_results_composite.RDS")
saveRDS(optimal_results_rmse, "optimal_parameter_results_rmse.RDS")
saveRDS(optimal_results_correlation, "optimal_parameter_results_correlation.RDS")

# Display comparison of different optimization approaches
cat("\n=== COMPARISON OF OPTIMIZATION APPROACHES ===\n")
cat("Weighted Composite (40-30-20-10) - Simulation:", optimal_results_composite_weighted$optimal_index, 
    "Score:", round(optimal_results_composite_weighted$optimal_metric_value, 4), "\n")
cat("Equal Composite (25-25-25-25) - Simulation:", optimal_results_composite_equal$optimal_index, 
    "Score:", round(optimal_results_composite_equal$optimal_metric_value, 4), "\n")
cat("Original Composite - Simulation:", optimal_results_composite$optimal_index, 
    "Score:", round(optimal_results_composite$optimal_metric_value, 4), "\n")
cat("RMSE Optimal - Simulation:", optimal_results_rmse$optimal_index,
    "RMSE:", round(optimal_results_rmse$optimal_metric_value, 4), "\n")
cat("Correlation Optimal - Simulation:", optimal_results_correlation$optimal_index,
    "Correlation:", round(optimal_results_correlation$optimal_metric_value, 4), "\n")

# Compare performance metrics between weighted and equal approaches
cat("\n=== DETAILED COMPARISON: WEIGHTED vs EQUAL WEIGHTING ===\n")
weighted_perf <- optimal_results_composite_weighted$optimal_performance
equal_perf <- optimal_results_composite_equal$optimal_performance

cat("WEIGHTED approach (40-30-20-10):\n")
cat("  RMSE:", round(weighted_perf$total_weighted_rmse, 4), "\n")
cat("  MAE:", round(weighted_perf$total_weighted_mae, 4), "\n") 
cat("  Bias:", round(abs(weighted_perf$total_weighted_bias), 4), "\n")
cat("  Correlation:", round(weighted_perf$avg_correlation, 4), "\n")
cat("  Composite:", round(weighted_perf$composite_score_weighted, 4), "\n")

cat("\nEQUAL approach (25-25-25-25):\n")
cat("  RMSE:", round(equal_perf$total_weighted_rmse, 4), "\n")
cat("  MAE:", round(equal_perf$total_weighted_mae, 4), "\n")
cat("  Bias:", round(abs(equal_perf$total_weighted_bias), 4), "\n")
cat("  Correlation:", round(equal_perf$avg_correlation, 4), "\n")
cat("  Composite:", round(equal_perf$composite_score_equal, 4), "\n")

cat("\nDifference (Equal - Weighted):\n")
cat("  RMSE Δ:", round(equal_perf$total_weighted_rmse - weighted_perf$total_weighted_rmse, 4), "\n")
cat("  MAE Δ:", round(equal_perf$total_weighted_mae - weighted_perf$total_weighted_mae, 4), "\n")
cat("  Bias Δ:", round(abs(equal_perf$total_weighted_bias) - abs(weighted_perf$total_weighted_bias), 4), "\n")
cat("  Correlation Δ:", round(equal_perf$avg_correlation - weighted_perf$avg_correlation, 4), "\n")

# Use weighted approach as default for backward compatibility
# Compare performance across metrics for the composite score optimal model
best_model_performance <- optimal_results_composite_weighted$optimal_performance
cat("\n=== BEST MODEL (COMPOSITE SCORE) DETAILED PERFORMANCE ===\n")
cat("Weighted RMSE:", round(best_model_performance$total_weighted_rmse, 4), "\n")
cat("Weighted MAE:", round(best_model_performance$total_weighted_mae, 4), "\n")
cat("Weighted Bias:", round(best_model_performance$total_weighted_bias, 4), "\n")
cat("Average Correlation:", round(best_model_performance$avg_correlation, 4), "\n")
cat("Composite Score:", round(best_model_performance$composite_score, 4), "\n")

# Display optimal parameters for the best model
```

## Visualize Enhanced Uncertainty Analysis Results

```{r visualize-enhanced-results, eval=FALSE}
# Plot performance metric distributions
plot_enhanced_performance_distributions <- function(performance_results, metric_name) {
  require(ggplot2)
  
  metric_values <- sapply(performance_results, function(x) x[[metric_name]])
  
  df <- data.frame(
    Simulation = 1:length(metric_values),
    Value = metric_values
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Value)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of", metric_name),
      subtitle = paste("n =", length(metric_values), "simulations"),
      x = metric_name,
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE),
              color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
    annotate("text",
            x = mean(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE),
            y = max(table(cut(metric_values, 30))) * 0.8,
            label = paste("Mean =", round(mean(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3)),
            hjust = -0.1, color = "red")
  
  return(p)
}

# Create performance distribution plots
p_composite <- plot_enhanced_performance_distributions(
  enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance, "composite_score")
p_rmse <- plot_enhanced_performance_distributions(
  enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance, "total_weighted_rmse")
p_correlation <- plot_enhanced_performance_distributions(
  enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance, "avg_correlation")

# Save plots
ggsave("plots/enhanced_composite_score_distribution.png", p_composite,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("plots/enhanced_rmse_distribution.png", p_rmse,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("plots/enhanced_correlation_distribution.png", p_correlation,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Plot species-specific performance comparison
plot_species_performance_comparison <- function(performance_results, species_weights_df) {
  require(ggplot2)
  require(dplyr)
  
  # Extract species metrics from all simulations
  all_species_metrics <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:length(performance_results), function(i) {
    metrics <- performance_results[[i]]$metrics_by_species
    metrics$Simulation <- i
    return(metrics)
  }))
  
  # Add weights
  all_species_metrics <- all_species_metrics %>%
    left_join(species_weights_df, by = "Species") %>%
    mutate(weight = ifelse(is.na(weight), 1, weight),
           Species_Type = ifelse(Species %in% c("minke whales", "orca", "sperm whales", "baleen whales"),
                                "Whale (High Weight)", "Fish/Krill (Standard Weight)"))
  
  # Create boxplot
  p_species <- ggplot(all_species_metrics, aes(x = reorder(Species, RMSE, median), 
                                               y = RMSE, fill = Species_Type)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Whale (High Weight)" = "coral", 
                                "Fish/Krill (Standard Weight)" = "lightblue")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = "Species-Specific RMSE Distribution",
      subtitle = "Showing uncertainty across parameter combinations",
      x = "Species (ordered by median RMSE)",
      y = "RMSE",
      fill = "Species Group"
    )
  
  return(p_species)
}

p_species_comparison <- plot_species_performance_comparison(
  enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance, species_weights)
print(p_species_comparison)
ggsave("plots/enhanced_species_performance_comparison.png", p_species_comparison,
       width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

# Extract yield data from all simulations for uncertainty bounds
trimYield_uncertainty <- function(sim) {
  tryCatch({
    y <- plotYieldGear(sim, return_data = TRUE)
    y <- select(y, c(Year, Species, Yield))
    return(y)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Warning: Could not extract yield from simulation\n")
    return(NULL)
  })
}

sim_yields_uncertainty <- lapply(enhanced_uncertainty_results$simulations, trimYield_uncertainty)

  sim_yields_uncertainty[[i]]$sim <- i
}

  cat("Error: Could not extract yield data from any simulations\n")
  stop("Valid yield data required")

# Calculate uncertainty bounds for yield

  group_by(Species, Year) %>% 
  summarise(Yield = median(Yield), .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  ungroup()

sim_min_yield <- df_sim_yield_uncertainty %>% 
  group_by(Species, Year) %>% 
  summarise(Yield = min(Yield), .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  ungroup()

sim_max_yield <- df_sim_yield_uncertainty %>% 
  group_by(Species, Year) %>% 
  summarise(Yield = max(Yield), .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  ungroup()

sim_lower_yield <- df_sim_yield_uncertainty %>% 
  group_by(Species, Year) %>% 
  summarise(Yield = quantile(Yield, 0.025), .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  ungroup()

sim_upper_yield <- df_sim_yield_uncertainty %>% 
  group_by(Species, Year) %>% 
  summarise(Yield = quantile(Yield, 0.975), .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  ungroup()

getBiomassData <- function(sim) {
  tryCatch({
    biomass <- getBiomass(sim)
    df_biomass <- reshape2::melt(biomass)
    names(df_biomass) <- c("Year", "Species", "Biomass")
    return(df_biomass)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Warning: Could not extract biomass from simulation\n")
    return(NULL)
  })
}

  geom_point(data = yield_ts_tidy,

  )

## Export Optimal Parameters for Future Use

```{r export-optimal-params, eval=FALSE}
# Extract optimal parameters for future simulations
optimal_params_export <- params_1841_2010_fishing_only

# Update with optimal catchability
gear_df <- gear_params(optimal_params_export)
gear_df$catchability <- optimal_results$optimal_params$catchability
gear_params(optimal_params_export) <- gear_df

# Update with optimal marine mammal scaling
sp_params <- species_params(optimal_params_export)
mammal_indices <- which(sp_params$species %in% optimal_results$optimal_params$marine_mammal_species)
for (i in seq_along(mammal_indices)) {
  optimal_params_export@initial_n[mammal_indices[i],] <-
    optimal_params_export@initial_n[mammal_indices[i],] *
    optimal_results$optimal_params$marine_mammal_scaling[i]
}

# Run to steady state (preserving erepro if needed)
# Check if we want to preserve erepro based on the original analysis
preserve_erepro_export <- TRUE  # Set this based on your preference
if (preserve_erepro_export) {
  optimal_params_export <- steady(optimal_params_export, tol = 0.01, t_max = 500, preserve = c("erepro"))
} else {
  optimal_params_export <- steady(optimal_params_export, tol = 0.01, t_max = 500)
  # Check final erepro values
  final_erepro <- species_params(optimal_params_export)$erepro
  if (any(final_erepro > 1, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    warning("Some species have erepro > 1 in the optimal parameters:")
    print(data.frame(
      Species = sp_params$species[which(final_erepro > 1)],
      erepro = final_erepro[which(final_erepro > 1)]
    ))
  }
}

# Save optimal parameters
saveRDS(optimal_params_export, "params_optimal_combined_uncertainty.RDS")

cat("\nOptimal parameters saved to 'params_optimal_combined_uncertainty.RDS'\n")
```
## Adaptive Uncertainty Analysis with Species-Specific Refinement

This section implements an improved adaptive approach that checks RMSE every 10 simulations and refines the parameter search space based on performance, with special attention to species with poor fits.

### Run Adaptive Uncertainty Analysis

The adaptive approach gradually refines the search space, focusing on parameter combinations that show promise while specifically tracking species that have poor fits (like Antarctic krill and minke whales). All necessary functions are included in Helper_Functions.R.

```{r run-adaptive-analysis, eval=FALSE}
# Load required data if not already loaded
if (!exists("combined_effort_array")) {
  combined_effort_array <- readRDS("effort_array_1841_2010.rds")
}

if (!exists("yield_ts_tidy")) {
  yield_ts_tidy <- readRDS("yield_observed_timeseries_tidy.RDS")
}

# Run adaptive uncertainty analysis
# This will check RMSE every 10 simulations and refine the search space
adaptive_results <- run_adaptive_uncertainty_analysis(
  params = params_1841_2010_fishing_only,
  n_total_sims = 500,  # Total number of simulations
  check_interval = 10,  # Check and refine every 10 simulations (more frequent updates)
  initial_catchability_sd = 0.3,  # Start with wider search
  initial_abundance_sd = 0.4,  # Start with wider search
  marine_mammal_species = c("minke whales", "orca", "sperm whales", "baleen whales", "shelf and coastal fishes"),
  fished_species = c("antarctic krill", "bathypelagic fishes",
                    "shelf and coastal fishes", "squids", "toothfishes",
                    "minke whales", "orca", "sperm whales", "baleen whales"),
  effort_scen = combined_effort_array,
  yield_obs_data = yield_ts_tidy,
  year_range = c(1961, 2010),
  tol = 0.01,
  t_max = 500,
  spinup_years = 118,
  t_start = 1841,
  sim_years = 170,
  preserve_erepro = TRUE,
  max_erepro = 1,
  convergence_threshold = 0.01,  # Stop refining if improvement < 1%
  n_cores = NULL,  # Use all available cores minus 1
  parallel = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE  # Show progress and species-specific issues
)

# Validate the adaptive results to ensure all simulations are valid
cat("\nValidating adaptive analysis results...\n")
adaptive_results_cleaned <- validate_simulation_results(adaptive_results, verbose = TRUE)

# Save adaptive results
saveRDS(adaptive_results_cleaned, "adaptive_uncertainty_results.RDS")

# Display summary
cat("\n=== Adaptive Analysis Summary ===\n")
cat("Total simulations:", adaptive_results$optimal$total_simulations, "\n")
cat("Optimal RMSE:", round(adaptive_results$optimal$optimal_rmse, 3), "\n")
cat("RMSE range:", round(range(adaptive_results$all_rmse), 3), "\n")

# Display runtime information
cat("\n=== Runtime Information ===\n")
cat("Total runtime:", round(adaptive_results$optimal$runtime$total_minutes, 1), "minutes\n")
cat("Average time per simulation:", round(adaptive_results$optimal$runtime$avg_time_per_simulation, 1), "seconds\n")
cat("Parallel processing:", ifelse(adaptive_results$optimal$runtime$parallel_used,
                                  paste("YES (", adaptive_results$optimal$runtime$n_cores_used, " cores)", sep=""),
                                  "NO (sequential)"), "\n")

cat("\nSpecies-specific RMSE (best simulation):\n")
best_species_rmse <- adaptive_results$species_rmse[[adaptive_results$optimal$optimal_index]]
for (sp in names(best_species_rmse)) {
  cat("  ", sp, ":", round(best_species_rmse[[sp]], 3), "\n")
}
```

### Compare Adaptive vs. Standard Approach

```{r compare-approaches, eval=FALSE}
# Load standard approach results if available
if (file.exists("combined_uncertainty_results.RDS")) {
  standard_results <- readRDS("combined_uncertainty_results.RDS")
  
  # Compare RMSE distributions
  df_comparison <- data.frame(
    RMSE = c(adaptive_results$all_rmse,
             sapply(standard_results$simulations, function(sim) {
               calculate_yield_rmse(sim, yield_ts_tidy,
                                  species_list = c("antarctic krill", "bathypelagic fishes",
                                                  "shelf and coastal fishes", "squids", "toothfishes",
                                                  "minke whales", "orca", "sperm whales", "baleen whales"),
                                  year_range = c(1961, 2010))$total_rmse
             })),
    Method = c(rep("Adaptive", length(adaptive_results$all_rmse)),
              rep("Standard", length(standard_results$simulations)))
  )
  
  p_comparison <- ggplot(df_comparison, aes(x = Method, y = RMSE, fill = Method)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Adaptive" = "darkgreen", "Standard" = "steelblue")) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = "RMSE Comparison: Adaptive vs. Standard Uncertainty Analysis",
         subtitle = "Adaptive approach refines search space every 50 simulations",
         y = "RMSE") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  print(p_comparison)
  ggsave("plots/adaptive_vs_standard_comparison.png", p_comparison,
         width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  
  # Statistical comparison
  cat("\n=== Statistical Comparison ===\n")
  cat("Adaptive - Min RMSE:", round(min(adaptive_results$all_rmse), 3), "\n")
  cat("Standard - Min RMSE:", round(min(df_comparison$RMSE[df_comparison$Method == "Standard"]), 3), "\n")
  cat("Improvement:",
      round((min(df_comparison$RMSE[df_comparison$Method == "Standard"]) -
             min(adaptive_results$all_rmse)) /
            min(df_comparison$RMSE[df_comparison$Method == "Standard"]) * 100, 1), "%\n")
  
  # Compare runtimes if available
  if (!is.null(adaptive_results$optimal$runtime)) {
    cat("\n=== Runtime Comparison ===\n")
    cat("Adaptive approach runtime:", round(adaptive_results$optimal$runtime$total_minutes, 1), "minutes\n")
    cat("Time per simulation:", round(adaptive_results$optimal$runtime$avg_time_per_simulation, 1), "seconds\n")
    cat("Efficiency note: Adaptive approach focuses computational effort on promising regions\n")
  }
}
```

```{r apply-adaptive-optimal, eval=FALSE}
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = paste("Adaptive Optimization Result:", sp),
         subtitle = paste("RMSE =", round(best_species_rmse[[sp]], 3)),
         x = "Year", y = "Yield") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(1961, 2010), linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.5)
  
  print(p_sp)
  ggsave(paste0("plots/adaptive_", gsub(" ", "_", sp), "_comparison.png"),
         p_sp, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
```

```{r export-adaptive-optimal, eval=FALSE}
# Create parameter object with optimal values
params_optimal_adaptive <- params_1841_2010_fishing_only

# Apply optimal catchability
gear_df <- gear_params(params_optimal_adaptive)
gear_df$catchability <- optimal_params_adaptive$catchability
gear_params(params_optimal_adaptive) <- gear_df

# Apply optimal marine mammal scaling
sp_params <- species_params(params_optimal_adaptive)
mammal_indices <- which(sp_params$species %in% optimal_params_adaptive$marine_mammal_species)
for (i in seq_along(mammal_indices)) {
  params_optimal_adaptive@initial_n[mammal_indices[i],] <-
    params_optimal_adaptive@initial_n[mammal_indices[i],] *
    optimal_params_adaptive$marine_mammal_scaling[i]
}

# Run to steady state
params_optimal_adaptive <- steady(params_optimal_adaptive,
                                 tol = 0.01,
                                 t_max = 500,
                                 preserve = c("erepro"))

# Save optimal parameters
saveRDS(params_optimal_adaptive, "params_optimal_adaptive.RDS")
cat("\nOptimal parameters from adaptive search saved to 'params_optimal_adaptive.RDS'\n")
```
